column3: Records every player's rating from a match into the month ratings. \n `MONTH_RATINGS::record_match_ratings(game, fixture)`, called by 0x7683a0 for every match of the leagues that have a monthly award. Both sides of the match (+0x190 and +0x190 + 0x625), 20 slots of `match_record_row::SIZE` bytes each: except the slot whose `.position()` is `row_slot::EMPTY` and, from the 12th slot on, the substitute who did not come on (`.minute_on()` = 0xff), the person (id at +0) below the person count `G_STAFF_COUNT` goes to the month ratings (`exe::month_ratings_add_player_rating`).

Finds or appends the person's record in the month ratings table, adds the rating and counts one match. \n `MONTH_RATINGS::add_player_rating(e)`. The table at [this] (count at +4, capacity at +8) has 12-byte records: +0 person, +4 club's league (or −1), +8 sum of the ratings, `month_rating_entry::MATCHES` matches, `month_rating_entry::AGE` age. It finds the slot's person (+0) or appends it (growing by 300 with malloc `exe::crt_malloc` or realloc `exe::crt_realloc` when full; the league from the person's `.club_job()` and that club's `.division()`; the age from the person's `.age()`) and adds the rating (`add_match_rating`).

Sorts the month ratings by average and returns the best player of a league, with an optional age filter. \n `MONTH_RATINGS::find_best_player(league, age)`, used by the monthly award (`award_best_rated_player`). It sorts the table by average (qsort `exe::crt_qsort` with 0x768200: those with fewer than 3 matches go to the end) and returns the first record of the league (−1: any) with at least 3 `month_rating_entry::MATCHES` (then 2, 1 and 0); with an age (not 0xff), those whose `month_rating_entry::AGE` is above it are only counted and the youngest only qualifies after 3 have been counted; with a league, the current league of the person's club (`staff::CLUB_JOB`, `.division()`) must also be the requested one. None: 0.

Creates the Trophy section stage: a knockout (Cup_Stage) with the 56 clubs in list order (North, then South), using the rounds of stage 0 of the cup table, no seeding. \n `EngAutoCup::create_section_stage()`; SEH frame only for the new, no destructor. The section stage (North and South) with the `.team_count()` clubs of list `eng_auto_cup::SELECTED_CLUBS`, in order: a vector (`exe::crt_malloc` of 4 × `.team_count()`; out of memory, the box for line 0x2e9) holding them; the rounds through method `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE` (push 0; push &extra; push &rounds; push 0; mov ecx -> thiscall, ret 0x10); the stage (`exe::crt_operator_new`(0xb2); Cup_Stage::Cup_Stage `FN_CUP_STAGE_CUP_STAGE`, thiscall, ret 0x3c: the cup, `.team_count()` (word), the vector, the rounds (word), +4, the table, the year `.year()` (word), 0, 1, the extra (word), `.importance_bias()` (byte), 0, 0, 0, no seeds; the words and bytes are pushed with garbage in the upper bits, which the constructor does not read) into `.stages()`[0]; the vector and the table are freed (`exe::crt_free`). Without a stage, the box for line 0x300; with it, `.set_current_stage(0)`.

Moves the Trophy on by one stage; when the sections end (stage 1) it builds the final between the North and South winners; at the last stage, the error box. \n `EngAutoCup::advance_stage()`, virtual +0x28. At the last stage (`.current_stage()` ≥ `.stage_count()` − 1, signed), the box for line 0x314 and nothing else; otherwise `.current_stage()` goes up by one and, on reaching 1 (the end of the sections), it builds the final (EngAutoCup::create_final_stage `exe::engautocup_create_final_stage`, direct call with the cup's ecx -> thiscall, ret 0).

Builds the Trophy final when the sections end: a single tie (2-team Cup_Stage, stage 1) between the club still alive in the cup list and the one still alive in the section stage, and draws the round at once (home side). \n `EngAutoCup::create_final_stage()`; from the next stage, SEH frame only for the new, no destructor. The Trophy final: a vector of 2 (`exe::crt_malloc` of 8; out of memory, the box for line 0x337) with the first club of status 1 (the one still alive [inference]) in the cup list (`.team_table()`) and the first of status 1 in the section stage list (`.stages()`[0] + `cup::TEAM_TABLE`), both among the first `.team_count()` (of the cup); the rounds through method `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE` (push 0; push &extra; push &rounds; push 1; mov ecx -> thiscall, ret 0x10); the stage (`exe::crt_operator_new`(0xb2); Cup_Stage::Cup_Stage `FN_CUP_STAGE_CUP_STAGE`, thiscall, ret 0x3c: the cup, 2, the vector, the rounds (word), +4, the table, the year `.year()` (word), 1, 1, the extra (word), 0x14, 0, 0, 0, no seeds) into `.stages()`[1]; the round table is freed (`exe::crt_free`). Without a stage, the box for line 0x35a (the vector is left allocated, as in the original). With it, the round draw (Cup::draw_round `exe::cup_draw_round`: push 0; mov ecx, stage -> thiscall, ret 4) and the vector is freed.

Writes the Trophy final ranking into the cup statistics: the highest-reputation club of each half takes 1st and 2nd; the others share one position per round, from the last round to the first. \n `EngAutoCup::rank_teams()`, the virtual for the final ranking (n = 1 up to 2002-06-01). The final position of each club in the cup statistics (+8, Comp_Stats; without them, the box for line 0x3bb). A vector of 2 × `.team_count()` pointers (`exe::crt_malloc`; out of memory, the box for line 0x3c3): in the first half the clubs of the cup list (`.team_table()`, 6-byte entries), in the second those of the section stage (`.stages()`[0] + `cup::TEAM_TABLE`); each half sorted by reputation (`club::REPUTATION`, word), highest first (qsort `exe::crt_qsort` with 0x4b07d0). The first two (the highest-reputation club of each half): the one with the higher reputation (signed, strictly) is 1st and the other 2nd (Comp_Stats::set_club_final_position `exe::comp_stats_set_club_final_position`: push position; push club; mov ecx, +8 -> thiscall, ret 8). Then, for each half, from the last round (`.round_count()` − 1) to the first, as many clubs (the next ones of the half, from the 2nd on) as the round has in `cup_round::TIES` of the round table (`.round_table()`, `cup_round::SIZE` bytes per round), with positions 3, 5, 7... (3, then 3 + 2 × those already placed). The original pushes the dword of the position byte with stack garbage in the upper bits; `exe::comp_stats_set_club_final_position` only reads the byte. The vector is freed.

Rule: group 1 of the Copa Merconorte has 4 clubs, the first 4 drawn, each in the row of its order; human managers get the group draw news. \n The table of the Merconorte's first group: 4 teams (`.set_club_count(4)`), the table `.set_table()` (`exe::crt_malloc`(0xec): push 0xec; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; 4 rows of 0x3b bytes; out of memory, the error box at line 0x145 and returns 0), each row i with drawn club i (`con_merc_cup_drawn_club`) (`exe::league_init_table_row` League::init_table_row: push 0; push 0; push club; push i; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x10), the group draw news (`exe::league_send_group_draw_news`: mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0) and returns 1. The same body as `init_group_a_table` of the African Cup (only the file and the error box line change).

Rule: each of the other groups of the Copa Merconorte is a league stage with the next 4 drawn clubs (4g + 4 to 4g + 7), the cup's rules and year and the cup's round table for the group; human managers get the news. \n SEH frame only for the stage's new: no destructor on the normal path. Builds the stage of group g + 1 (g from 0 to 2, on the draw day). The teams in a vector of 4 pointers (`exe::crt_malloc`(0x10): push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; out of memory, the error box at line 0x1e9 and 0): drawn clubs 4g + 4 to 4g + 7 (`con_merc_cup_drawn_club`); the round table through virtual `comp_vtable::CREATE_SCHEDULE` (push 0; push &id; push &rounds; push g; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x10); the stage (`exe::crt_operator_new`(0xee) push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; the League_Stage constructor `FN_LEAGUE_STAGE_LEAGUE_STAGE`, thiscall, ret 0x58, 22 arguments: the cup, the teams (4), the vector, `.legs()` (word), `.competition()`, the round table, the rounds (word), `.win_points()`, `.draw_points()`, `.match_category()`, &`league::TIEBREAKS`, &`league::PROMOTED_COUNT`, the year `.year()` (word), g, the id (word), `.importance()`, 2, 0, `.league_flags()` (word), −1, 0, 2; the original pushes the words and bytes with garbage in the high bytes, which the constructor does not read: the copy passes clean values) into `.stages()`[g]; the vector and the round table freed (`exe::crt_free`). No stage: the error box at line 0x1ff and 0. With it: the group news (`exe::league_send_group_draw_news` on the stage), `.set_current_stage(g)` and 1.

rule: the UEFA Cup has, only when there are preliminary clubs (`uefa_cup::PRELIMINARY_CLUB_COUNT`, those with coefficient 10 or more [inference]), a preliminary round drawn on 28/6 and played on 6/7 (b teams); then: 1st qualifying round drawn on 28/7 and played on 10/8 (82 teams, 0x52 − b/2 new), 2nd on 14/9 (96 teams, 55 new), 1st round on 19/10 (48 teams), 2nd on 23/11 (32 teams, 8 new), 3rd on 1/3 of the following year, round of 16 on 15/3, quarter-finals on 5/4 and the single-match final on 16/5 (venue 4, prize of 1.5 million to the winner); two legs 14 days apart (7 in the 3rd round and the round of 16); category 7 in qualifying and 8 after

Returns the fixture list for a year, day, slice and key nation, switching the other year block to the requested year or creating it. \n `FIXTURE_MANAGER::get_fixture_list(year, day, slice, kind)`; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path. The list of fixtures of the year, day (word), slice (byte) and key nation (signed byte) in the chain of year blocks. By the block's year (`fixture_manager::YEAR`): if the other block (`fixture_manager::OTHER_YEAR`) is not of that year, it is switched to the year (`exe::fixture_manager_set_year`: push year; ecx = the other -> thiscall, ret 4); without the other block, a new block (`exe::crt_operator_new`, 0x1184 bytes; `exe::new_fixture_manager`: push 0; push this; push year; ecx = the new one -> thiscall, ret 0xc) goes into `fixture_manager::OTHER_YEAR`; out of memory, the box for line 0x681 and 0. The list: [[block + (day·3 + slice)·4] + kind·4].

Reads fixtures_<year>.tmp: each 0x4f-byte fixture gets its club, competition and stadium pointers and goes into the list of its day, slice and key nation. \n `FIXTURE_MANAGER::load_fixtures()`. The name `fixtures_<year>.tmp` at `fixture_manager::FILE_NAME` (`FN_CRT_SPRINTF`) and, with a year (`fixture_manager::YEAR`, unsigned) from 1980 on and the file in CM3_TEMP (`exe::utils_build_file_path`: push name; push "CM3_TEMP"; add esp, 8 -> cdecl; `exe::crt_fopen` fopen with "rb"), the count (dword) and the 0x4f-byte fixtures (`exe::crt_fread` fread; on failure, the box for line 0x730 or 0x73e and the file is closed): the club ids (`.home_club_id()`, `.away_club_id()` → `.set_home_club()`, `.set_away_club()`), the competition id (+0 → `.set_competition()`, 0x6b bytes in `G_CLUB_COMP_TABLE`) and the stadium id (`.stadium_id()` → `.set_stadium()`, 0x4e bytes in `G_STADIUM_TABLE`, 0 outside `G_STADIUM_COUNT`) become pointers (id -1: the game stops, lines 0x74b, 0x751, 0x758), and the fixture goes (`exe::llist_add_tail`: push 0x4f; push &fixture; ecx = the list -> thiscall, ret 8; on failure, the game stops, 0x785) into the list of the fixture's day (`.day()`), slice (`.time_slice()`) and key nation (`exe::comp_active_key_nation_of_fixture`: push &fixture; push competition; add esp, 8 -> cdecl). At the end, fclose (`exe::crt_fclose`).

Collects the clashes of a fixture on its day plus an offset: forbidden dates, fixtures of the same club or stadium, national teams and big clubs, and fixtures already played. \n `FIXTURE_MANAGER::collect_day_clashes(game, grav, list, nations, n, data, desloc)`; SEH frame only for the dates. Used for a fixture's clashes (`find_fixture_clashes`) on day `data` + `desloc` (`exe::date_add_days`: push 16-bit n; push &local; ecx = date -> thiscall, ret 8). A cup (`.category()` = 1) only on the day itself. On the day itself, the forbidden dates give 19 and return: 25 December (except in the competitions of the nation of `KEY_NATION_JAPAN`), Sunday in those of the nation of `KEY_NATION_NORTHERN_IRELAND` (`exe::date_get_weekday`: ecx = date -> thiscall), 10 to 20 April in those of `KEY_NATION_GREECE` (the dates through `exe::date_date_549f70`: 4 pushes -> thiscall); 17 May with a club of nation `KEY_NATION_NORWAY` (also with an offset, without returning, if it is the day itself). Then, for each nation in `nations` (except the 0xff ones) and each of the 3 slices, the day list (`exe::fixture_manager_get_fixture_list`: ecx = manager; 4 pushes -> thiscall, ret 0x10) with the cursor at the start: each fixture in it (`exe::llist_get_next`) that shares a club and slice (`fixture::HOME_SIDE_MARK`/`fixture::AWAY_SIDE_MARK`) goes in by type; a club in another slice goes in with 0x14 or 1 by `fixture::TIME_SLICE` and by type 1; the same stadium (`fixture::STADIUM`) outside the competition of `KEY_CLUB_COMP_WORLD_CUP_OCEANIA_QUALIFYING_SECTION`, likewise; the national teams of the clubs' nation (`exe::database_get_national_team`: push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl) and the clubs with `.reputation()` above 5000 by the competition rule (+0x60, `comp_clash_rule`); fixtures of the competition of `KEY_CLUB_COMP_AMERICAN_MLS_ALL_STARS` with a club of the league of `KEY_CLUB_COMP_AMERICAN_MAJOR_LEAGUE` give 19; a fixture already played (`fixture::HOME_GOALS`) gives 0x16. Missing club: the box and the game ends (as in the original).

Finds a fixture's clashes: builds the nations to check, creates the clash list and collects the clashes of the surrounding days; returns the severity and the list, or 0 with no clash. \n `FIXTURE_MANAGER::find_fixture_clashes(game, out, two_days)`, used by the calendar (`add_fixture`, `find_new_fixture_date`, `resolve_same_day_clash`, `move_nearby_club_fixtures`); SEH frame for the new list. Without a fixture or without an output: the box (as in the original). It zeroes the output; the nations to check, without repeats: 0 to 6, the fixture's key nation (`exe::comp_active_key_nation_of_fixture`: 2 pushes; add esp, 8 -> cdecl), those of the two clubs' leagues, the stadium's (`exe::comp_active_key_nation_of_stadium`: push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl), the partners (`exe::fix_man_get_partner_key_nation_index`: push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl) and, with a home national team (`exe::database_is_national_team`), those of the two national teams (`exe::comp_active_key_nation_of_club`: push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl). Key 3 or 5 outside the competition of `KEY_CLUB_COMP_FIFA_CLUB_WORLD_CHAMPIONSHIP` turns off the two days before. The new list (new 0xe: `exe::crt_operator_new`, push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; `exe::new_llist`: ecx = block -> thiscall; out of memory, the box and 0) and the clashes of each day (`exe::fixture_manager_collect_day_clashes`: ecx = this; 7 pushes -> thiscall, ret 0x1c) from the fixture's date (`exe::new_date`: push `.year()`; push `.day()`; ecx = local -> thiscall): below `.category()` 0x17, the two days before (with the flag) and the day before; the day itself and the day after; again the two days before with the flag. With no clash: the list is destroyed and freed (`exe::drop_llist`: ecx = list -> thiscall; `exe::crt_operator_delete`: push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl), 0x15 in the output if the national team forbids it (`exe::nationalteams_can_schedule_club_fixture`: ecx = [`G_NATIONAL_TEAMS`]; push fixture -> thiscall, ret 4) and 0. Otherwise the severity in the output and the list.

Clears the leg check list at `G_FIXTURE_LEGS_LIST` and refills it with the 15-byte records of check_fixture_legs.tmp. \n `fix_man_load_fixture_leg_checks()` (cdecl), from the construction of the main calendar (`exe::new_fixture_manager`, on load and on game creation): empties the leg check list `G_FIXTURE_LEGS_LIST` (`exe::llist_clear`: ecx = list -> thiscall) and rebuilds it with the 15-byte records of check_fixture_legs.tmp in the temporary folder (`exe::utils_build_file_path`: 2 pushes; add esp, 8 -> cdecl; fopen `exe::crt_fopen` "rb", fread `exe::crt_fread`, fclose `exe::crt_fclose`: cdecl), using the 16-bit count at the start; a short record: the box (line 0x10b9) and whatever was left in the record goes in (`exe::llist_add_tail`).

Finds a new date for a fixture: within a window by fixture type, it tries weekdays in a fixed order and keeps the first date with no (or tolerable) clash; otherwise 2 days later. \n `FIXTURE_MANAGER::find_new_fixture_date(game)`, used by calendar entry (`add_fixture`), by same-day clashes (`resolve_same_day_clash`) and by rescheduling (`move_nearby_club_fixtures`); SEH frame only for the dates. Without a fixture: the box (as in the original). If the units digit of the round (`.round_name()`, `exe::comp_util_get_round_variant`: push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl) is 3 or 4, the fixture's 15-byte record goes into the leg check list `G_FIXTURE_LEGS_LIST` (`exe::llist_add_tail`). The window by type (`.category()`): 2, up to the date at `.next_round_year()`/`.next_round_day()` (without it, the box and 2 weeks), starting 4 weeks later (if the end is more than 20 weeks away) or 3 days later; 4 and 6, from 3 days to 2 weeks; 5, from 0 to 1 week; 7, 8 and 10, from 3 days before to 1 week; the others, none. In two passes (the second checking the two days before), through the weekdays in the order 2, 1, 5, 6, 0, 3, 4, every 4 days of the window: the target day (`nearest_weekday`) from 2 days after today and inside the window becomes the date (`.set_year()`, `.set_day()`) and the time slot (`.set_time_slice()`, `fixture_time_slice`); with no clash (`fix_man_find_fixture_clashes`), or with severity 1 or below the type, it stays. Not found: 2 days after the fixture's date (or after today, if it has already passed).

Adds a fixture to the calendar: fixes the stage, reschedules late fixtures, moves weekend league fixtures to the home club's preferred day, resolves clashes, handles national team fixtures and neighbours, and puts the fixture in the day list or in the other year's block. \n `FIXTURE_MANAGER::add_fixture(game, clear)`, used by the cups, leagues, friendlies and rescheduling (20 callers); SEH frame for the dates and the new manager. `clear` zeroes the count of chained reschedulings (word `G_ADD_FIXTURE_RETRY_COUNT`). It fixes the stage (`exe::fix_man_record_club_fixture_years`: push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl), `.set_referee(−1)`; a fixture whose date has already passed and is not played: new date (`exe::fixture_manager_find_new_fixture_date`). A league fixture of the home club's league (`.division()` or `.reserve_division()`) with no round (`.round_name()`, `.round_prefix()`) and no stage (`.stage()`), once (bit 0x800 of `.squad_rules()`): on Saturday or Sunday, it moves to the home club's preferred day (`.match_day()`: 4, 5 or 6) if there is no clash there. With fewer than 10 chained reschedulings, the clashes (`fix_man_find_fixture_clashes`): severity 0x14, the same-day clash (`exe::fixture_manager_resolve_same_day_clash`) and 1; a cup or type 9 refused by the competition (`comp_vtable::ACCEPTS_FIXTURE`): 0; severity at least the type: 0 if the fixture's national team has a call-up (`exe::comp_is_reserve_or_minor_comp` on [`G_RESERVE_COMP`]), otherwise a new date and it goes in again; otherwise it goes in (`exe::fixture_manager_insert_fixture`) and the clashing fixtures leave: the friendlies (`FN_FRIENDLY_IS_FRIENDLY_COMPETITION`/`exe::friendly_on_friendly_fixture_cancelled` on [`G_FRIENDLY`]), type 9 (`exe::fixture_manager_remove_fixture`), the others rescheduled (`exe::fixture_manager_remove_fixture`, `exe::fixture_manager_find_new_fixture_date`, `exe::fixture_manager_add_fixture`) with the news (`FN_FIXTURE_MANAGER_QUEUE_FIXTURE_MOVED_NEWS` on [`G_FIXTURE_MANAGER`]). In the block's year (`fixture_manager::YEAR`): the key nation (`exe::comp_active_key_nation_of_fixture`), the order (`exe::fixture_manager_add_away_trip_illness_risk`), the national team fixtures (`exe::reservecomp_add_b_or_under21_fixture` on [`G_RESERVE_COMP`], `exe::nationalteams_select_squads_for_fixture` on [`G_NATIONAL_TEAMS`]), the neighbours (`exe::fixture_manager_move_nearby_club_fixtures`, key 3 or 5); if it did not go in, into the list of the day, slice and key (`exe::llist_add_tail`). Outside the year, into the other year's block (`fixture_manager::OTHER_YEAR`: `exe::fixture_manager_set_year` for the year, or a new one of 0x1184 bytes, `exe::new_fixture_manager`; out of memory, the box and 0).

Switches a fixture block to another year: saves the year's fixtures, moves the other block to the neighbouring year if needed, destroys the 366 days' lists, switches the year and leap flag, creates new lists and loads the new year's fixtures. \n `FIXTURE_MANAGER::set_year(year)`, used by calendar entry (`add_fixture`, the other year's block), by saving and removing fixtures and by the friendlies; SEH frame for the new blocks. If the same year (word, `fixture_manager::YEAR`): returns 1. Otherwise: it writes the year's fixtures (`exe::fixture_manager_save_fixtures`: ecx = block; push 0 -> thiscall; on failure, the box and 0); if the other block (`fixture_manager::OTHER_YEAR`) is in the requested year, it moves to the year neighbouring this one's (`exe::fixture_manager_set_year` on it); it destroys and frees the lists of the 366 days × 3 slices × key nations (`G_KEY_NATION_ACTIVE_COUNT`, signed byte; `exe::drop_llist`, `exe::crt_operator_delete`); the other block in the requested year, if this is the main one (`fixture_manager::IS_PRIMARY`), is destroyed and freed (`exe::drop_fixture_manager`: ecx = block -> thiscall; `exe::crt_operator_delete`); the new year, leap flag at `fixture_manager::LEAP_YEAR` (`exe::date_is_leap_year`: push year; add esp, 4 -> cdecl), the new lists (new 0xe: `exe::crt_operator_new`, push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; `exe::new_llist`: ecx = block -> thiscall; out of memory, the box and 0) and the loading of the year's fixtures (`exe::fixture_manager_load_fixtures`: ecx = block -> thiscall). Returns 1.

Writes the club dates table `G_CLUB_FIXTURE_YEAR_TABLE`, one word per club ([0xae235c]), into CM3_TEMP\club_dates.tmp. \n `fix_man_save_club_dates()` (cdecl), from the calendar save (FIXTURE_MANAGER::save `exe::fixture_manager_save_fixtures`, 0x5ac394): without the club dates table (`G_CLUB_FIXTURE_YEAR_TABLE`), the "Error" box for line 0x1011 (fix_man.cpp). It writes into CM3_TEMP\club_dates.tmp ("wb") one word per club ([0xae235c] of them, fwrite `exe::crt_fwrite`); a short write: the box for line 0x101b; then it closes the file. If the file does not open: nothing.

Allocates the club dates table `G_CLUB_FIXTURE_YEAR_TABLE` (one word per club) and reads it from CM3_TEMP\club_dates.tmp, or zeroes it without the file. \n `fix_man_load_club_dates()` (cdecl), from the calendar constructor (`exe::new_fixture_manager`, 0x5a9e38: on a new career and on loading the save). With the table already allocated (`G_CLUB_FIXTURE_YEAR_TABLE`), the "Error" box for line 0xfe4. It allocates one word per club (malloc `exe::crt_malloc` of 2 × [0xae235c]; out of memory, the box for line 0xfec); reads from CM3_TEMP\club_dates.tmp ("rb", fread `exe::crt_fread`; a short read: the box for line 0xff6) and closes it; without the file (a new career), it zeroes the table.

Writes the leg check list `G_FIXTURE_LEGS_LIST` into CM3_TEMP\check_fixture_legs.tmp: the count (2 bytes) and the 15-byte items. \n `fix_man_save_fixture_leg_checks()` (cdecl), from the calendar save (0x5ac399): with the leg check list (`G_FIXTURE_LEGS_LIST`, LLIST) empty (the count word zero), nothing. It writes into CM3_TEMP\check_fixture_legs.tmp ("wb") the count (2 bytes) and, from the start of the list (cursor `G_FIXTURE_LEGS_LIST_CURSOR` ← head `G_FIXTURE_LEGS_LIST_HEAD`), each 15-byte item (`exe::llist_get_next`; a short write: the "Error" box for line 0x10e0, and it carries on); then it closes the file. If the file does not open: nothing.

Resolves a new fixture falling on the same day as another: the one with higher priority stays and the other is moved to a new date, with the rescheduling news. \n `FIXTURE_MANAGER::resolve_same_day_clash(game, conflitos)`; SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path. The new fixture `game` falls on the same day as another, the first of the `conflitos` list (cursor `llist::CURSOR` goes back to the start +2 and `exe::llist_get_next` reads it); without either of them, the box for line 0xde6 and it returns 1. It copies both (0x4f bytes) and finds the target weekday from the date of the list's fixture (`fixture::DAY`, `fixture::YEAR`; `FN_DATE_DATE`, `exe::date_operator_3d`, `exe::date_get_weekday`): days 0 and 5 of `exe::date_get_weekday` go to 6, 1 and 3 to 2, 2 to 1, 4 and 6 to 5 (`exe::date_get_nearest_weekday` gives the date). Each one's priority is its competition's (`competition::REPUTATION` of `fixture::COMPETITION`), +0x15 (21) with a national team at home (`fixture::HOME_CLUB`, `exe::database_is_national_team`); the list's fixture leaves the day when the new one's priority is higher (or equal, with the new one's home club reputation `club::REPUTATION` higher) and it has not been played yet (`.home_goals()` = 0xff): it is removed from the calendar (`exe::fixture_manager_remove_fixture`) and the new one goes in (`exe::fixture_manager_add_fixture`); otherwise the new one leaves. The one that leaves gets the new date; with a clash there (`exe::fixture_manager_find_fixture_clashes`, the list destroyed and freed: `exe::drop_llist`, `exe::crt_operator_delete`), a fixed fixture (`fixture::CATEGORY` = 1) returns 0, otherwise `exe::fixture_manager_find_new_fixture_date` finds another date; it goes into the calendar (`exe::fixture_manager_add_fixture`) with the rescheduling news (`exe::fixture_manager_queue_fixture_moved_news`, caused by the other one). Returns 1.

Returns the club's first year with fixtures: 2001, or 2002 by bit 0 of its word in `G_CLUB_FIXTURE_YEAR_TABLE`. \n `FIXTURE_MANAGER::get_club_first_fixture_year(&id)`; this is not read. The first year with fixtures of club `[id]`: 2001, or 2002 with bit 0 of its word in `G_CLUB_FIXTURE_YEAR_TABLE`. Returns `ax` (the screen caller compares 16 bits).

Returns the club's last year with fixtures: its word in `G_CLUB_FIXTURE_YEAR_TABLE` without bit 0, or the current year. \n `FIXTURE_MANAGER::get_club_last_fixture_year(&id)`; this is not read. The club's last year with fixtures: its word in `G_CLUB_FIXTURE_YEAR_TABLE` without bit 0 (halved); with no year, the current year `G_CURRENT_DATE_YEAR`. Returns `ax` (the screen caller keeps 16 bits).

For a non-friendly fixture, moves the clubs' fixtures two days before one day earlier and those two days after one day later, if the new date is free, with the news. \n `FIXTURE_MANAGER::move_nearby_club_fixtures(game)`, from adding the fixture (`add_fixture`); SEH for the local list and the dates. A fixture of a friendly competition (`.competition()`, `fix_man_is_friendly_comp`): nothing. For both clubs (+0x1c, +0x20) of a nation (`.nation()`) with the flag `.league_selected()`: the club's first fixture two days before (`find_club_fixtures_between`, side 1), not a friendly and with +0x43 = 0xff, moves to one day before it; the first fixture two days after, not a friendly, moves to one day after it. Only if the new date has no other fixture (`new_date_has_clash`): it removes (`fix_man_remove_fixture`), adds (`fix_man_add_fixture`, 0) and posts the rescheduled fixture news (`fix_man_queue_fixture_moved_news`, with the fixture as the cause).

Reschedules the club's fixtures from one day before to one day after a national team date: each removed fixture gets a new date, is added back and posts the news with the old date. \n `FIXTURE_MANAGER::reschedule_club_fixtures_near_date(club, data)`, from the national team call-ups (0x777940: a club with more than two players called up); SEH for the local list. The club's fixtures (the id in `*club`) from one day before to one day after the date (`find_club_fixtures_between`, side 1); each one that leaves the calendar (`fix_man_remove_fixture`) gets a new date (`exe::fixture_manager_find_new_fixture_date`), goes back (`fix_man_add_fixture`, 1) and posts the news with the old date (`fix_man_queue_fixture_moved_news`, no cause).

Queues the "fixture moved" news: updates the new date of an existing news item for the same fixture, or queues news 1 with the fixture and the cause or the old date. \n `FIXTURE_MANAGER::queue_fixture_moved_news(f, causa, old)`, from the reschedulings (`add_fixture`, `reschedule_club_fixtures_near_date`, `resolve_same_day_clash`, `move_nearby_club_fixtures`); SEH for the local news. The queue at `fixture_manager::MOVED_NEWS_QUEUE` (created the first time: `exe::crt_operator_new` and `exe::new_llist`): if there is already news for the same fixture, it only changes the new date (data 5 and 6); otherwise news 1: the fixture (`fixture::HOME_CLUB_ID`, `fixture::AWAY_CLUB_ID`, +0, `fixture::ROUND_PREFIX`, `fixture::ROUND_NAME`, the new date `.day()`/`.year()`, `.home_side_mark()`, `.away_side_mark()`) and the cause (the same fields of it in data 7 to 0xd) or, with no cause, −1 and the old date (data 0xc and 0xd); it goes into the queue (`exe::llist_add_tail`, 0xdf).

Out of memory for the block: the box (line 0x3ff); a failed copy: the box (line 0x3eb).

Removes the first item with the same bytes from the fixture's day, slice and key-nation list; returns 1 if removed. \n `FIXTURE_MANAGER::remove_fixture(f)`: removes from the list of the fixture's day, slice and key nation (in the year block, through the chain) the first item with the same bytes (`exe::llist_remove`). Returns 1 if removed, 0 if not; out of memory for the block: the box (line 0x5ef) and 0.

Filters: kind (0xfe any), club side (0xff any) and competition (−1 any). Returns the count (word); a failed copy shows the box (line 0x93b) and stops there. Hot (288 thousand calls up to 2002-06-01): no counter.
