The end of the match day: frees the global list, the day's arrays and, for each match, the engine, the summary and the `day_match::SUMMARY` object. \n Frees the global list `G_MATCH_DAY_PLAYER_INCIDENT_LIST`, the two day arrays (`+1`, `+0xd`) and, for each match (`match_day_fields::MATCHES`, `0x69` bytes each, `match_day_fields::MATCH_COUNT` of them), the engine (`day_match::ENGINE`: `exe::drop_cm3_match_engine` and freed; the match leaves `G_VIRTUAL_STAFF` via `exe::virtual_staff_release_fixture`), the summary (`day_match::SCOREBOARD`) and the object at `day_match::SUMMARY` (`exe::match_team_pair_destructor`); finally the match array.

Clears each of the day's matches' fields and picks the human's match (or the first marked one) for the screen. Returns 1 if there was one of the human's. \n With matches on the day (`match_day_fields::HAS_INTEREST`), it clears the `0x40` bytes of each one (`match_day_fields::COMPETITIONS`, `0x54` bytes, `match_day_fields::COMPETITION_COUNT` of them) from `day_competition::PANEL` and picks the human's (`day_competition::HAS_MARKED`; otherwise the first with `day_competition::INTERESTING`) for the screen (`exe::open_day_fixtures_screen` and `exe::screenmanager_monitor` with `G_MATCH_DAY_SCREEN_SHOWING_FLAG` on).

Starts the day's next match after the current one (`match_day_fields::CURRENT_MATCH`): skips the decided ones, those of a human club and those already started; creates the engine and prepares it; in the 1st pass with none, moves to the 2nd. Returns 1 if it started one. \n Starts the next match of the day (`match_day_fields::MATCHES`, `0x69` bytes each, `match_day_fields::MATCH_COUNT` of them) after the current one (`match_day_fields::CURRENT_MATCH`; -2 = finished). The current one still with an engine (`+0x57`): error `0x68d`. It skips those already decided (`day_match::HOME_GOALS` -2), those with no match set in the 2nd pass (`match_day_fields::PASS` 1 and `day_match::DAY_COMPETITION`.`+0x10` zero), those of a human club (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club` with `day_match::HOME_SIDE_MARK`/`day_match::AWAY_SIDE_MARK`) and those already started (`day_match::HOME_GOALS` != -1, `day_match::ENGINE`, `day_match::MARKED`). \n On the chosen one: takes it off queue `G_VIRTUAL_STAFF` (`exe::virtual_staff_fill_fixture_squads` with -3), creates the engine (`0xf63b` bytes, `exe::new_cm3_match_engine`; without it error `0x6b2` and it carries on) and prepares it (`exe::cm3_match_engine_init_match` with the fast mode from `exe::match_day_can_quick_simulate`); `match_day_fields::CURRENT_MATCH` = it, returns 1. With none: in the 1st pass (`match_day_fields::PASS` 1) it moves to 2 and starts again from the beginning; otherwise `match_day_fields::CURRENT_MATCH` = -2 and returns 0.

Moves the day's current match (`match_day_fields::CURRENT_MATCH`) forward: one engine step (1 in 3 or 6 calls, by the modes in `G_CONFIG`) or to the end; when it finishes, creates the summary, records it, frees the engine and takes it off the queue. Returns 1 if the match finished. \n Without `until_end` (to the end), only 1 in every 3 (`0x40000` in `G_CONFIG`+4) or 6 (`0x80000`) calls, by counter `G_STEP_BACKGROUND_MATCH_COUNTER` (0..100), and one engine step (`exe::cm3_match_engine_run_match_steps` with 1); with `until_end`, steps (-1) to the end. The state goes to `day_match::STATE`; on finishing (2 or 8) it counts in `match_day_fields::FINISHED_COUNT`, creates the summary (`day_match::SUMMARY`, `0xd7a` bytes with 2 objects of `0x625` at `match_record::HOME_TEAM`; without it error `0x713`), records it (`exe::match_stats_record_match`), frees the engine and takes the match off queue `G_VIRTUAL_STAFF` (`exe::virtual_staff_release_fixture`).

Closes one of the day's matches: copies the day's match into the fixture, records the result in the competition (method 1, or the away-game path) and runs the post-match: players, events, contracts, suspensions, states, the history and each side's club. \n The closing of day match `p` (`0x69` bytes): copies the `0x4f` bytes from p+`day_match::FIXTURE_COPY` to the fixture (`+0`) and, with a competition (`fixture::COMPETITION`), reads the round number of a human club (`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE` of the competition `+8`, `exe::comp_stats_find_club_entry`, `.losing_run()` above 1; as in the original, it looks only at the away club `fixture::AWAY_CLUB` on both passes) and records the result: p+`day_match::HOME_GOALS` = -3 (away game, `exe::weather_post_abandoned_news` with bits 12-13 of `.squad_rules()` and the copy with scores -1 in `exe::fixture_manager_find_new_fixture_date`/`exe::fixture_manager_add_fixture`) or method 1 of the competition. \n Then the post-match with the summary (p+`day_match::SUMMARY`): players (`exe::match_day_apply_post_match_player_changes`), events (`exe::match_day_process_player_incidents`), contracts (`0x4ca6d0`), suspensions (`0x55ca00`), `0x76b600` (except for -3), states (`0x62c080`) and, except for -3, the history (`G_RESERVE_COMP` method 1, outside `KEY_CLUB_COMP_RESERVE`), `0x7c0d70`, `0x8c39f0`, `0x444930`, `0x868830`, `0x4134c0`, `0x6951e0`, `0x59a5d0`, `0x7f8c00` and the club of each side (`FN_MATCH_DAY_POST_PLAYER_REACTION_NEWS` with the round). Without `p`, error `0x73f` and 0.

Plays the match day: on a network it ties the humans to their matches and plays them to the end; then plays each match without an engine; finally closes each match, redoes the humans' stored tactics and frees the summaries. Returns 1. 
 Convention: thiscall, `match_day.cpp`, ~3.3 KB. Plays day `day` (`match_day_fields::MATCHES` matches of `0x69` bytes, `match_day_fields::MATCH_COUNT` of them, `match_day_fields::FINISHED_COUNT` finished, `match_day_fields::HUMAN_MATCH` the human's). It starts the next one (`exe::match_day_start_next_background_match`). On a network (`G_MATCH_ENGINE_ENABLED`): for each pending match with a human (`day_match::MARKED`) it creates the humans' scoreboard (`day_match::SCOREBOARD`, `0x11d` bytes), ties each human to his side (`exe::get_human_manager_record` `+0xe2`/`+0xe6`, `exe::open_manager_club_screen`, `exe::match_screens_open_waiting_screen_for_slot`), stores the highest level (`exe::human_manager_get_commentary_speed`) and passes it on (`exe::human_manager_set_commentary_speed`); then it notifies those not playing (`exe::open_latest_scores_screen`), releases the humans and plays their matches to the end. 
 Then, each match still without an engine (`day_match::HOME_GOALS` -1): with a human on a network, it moves the current one to the end (`exe::match_day_step_background_match`) and starts everything again; otherwise it creates the engine (`exe::new_cm3_match_engine`, `exe::cm3_match_engine_init_match`), plays to the end (`exe::cm3_match_engine_run_match_steps` -1, counting in `match_day_fields::FINISHED_COUNT`), creates the summary (`0xd7a` bytes), records it (`exe::match_stats_record_match`), frees the engine and, if the engine was not in fast mode (`+0` of the engine zero), writes the score with the day's percentage on the bar (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF`, `exe::screenmanager_send_network_status_message`). 
 Finally it moves the current one (`exe::match_day_step_background_match` with 1), closes each match (`exe::match_day_apply_match_result`), redoes the humans' stored tactics (`exe::human_manager_select_tactic_slot`, `exe::human_manager_get_active_tactic`, `exe::formation_clear_marking_targets`) and frees the summaries; with a score written, the date on the bar (`exe::date_get_long_date_string`).

Sets up the match day (date, mode 0..2): zeroes the arrays, gathers the pending matches of each list, records the already decided ones, groups by list and by competition, points each match to its competition, creates the global list and works out the day's interest. Returns the day. 
 Sets up day `day` with the matches of date `data` in mode `mode` (0, 1 or 2; otherwise or with no date, error `0x93`). Zeroes the day (`+0` mode; arrays `match_day_fields::GROUPS` groups of 24 bytes, `match_day_fields::COMPETITIONS` competitions of `0x54`, `match_day_fields::MATCHES` matches of `0x69`, each with capacity and count; `+0x2f` -1, `match_day_fields::PASS` 1). 
 For each of the `G_KEY_NATION_ACTIVE_COUNT` lists (`exe::fix_man_get_fixture_list_for_date`): the pending matches (`fixture::HOME_GOALS` <= -1, except -2) go into the day (copy of `0x4f` bytes; `day_match::STATE` -1), those decided earlier (`exe::weather_check_postponement` bit 0) are recorded and marked -2 (`exe::weather_post_postponed_news`, `exe::fixture_manager_find_new_fixture_date`/`exe::fixture_manager_add_fixture`), the others notified (`exe::officialsmanager_choose_match_official`); the list's group (`exe::comp_key_nation_entry_from_active_index`) stores the range of its matches, which is sorted (qsort with `0x6b6510`) and split by competition (`+4` of the copy), and each match points to its own (`+0x63`). 
 Finally the global list `G_MATCH_DAY_PLAYER_INCIDENT_LIST` (`exe::new_llist`) and the day's interest (`exe::match_day_refresh_human_interest_flags`). The arrays grow 5 at a time (`exe::crt_realloc`; out of memory, errors `0xd6`, `0xf4`, `0x140`).

The current human leaves the match he was watching; with no other human watching, the match runs to the end, is recorded and leaves the queue. \n The current human (`G_SCREEN_MANAGER_CURRENT_SLOT`) leaves the match he was watching (called only when a network player leaves, `0x838c00`). His match (`[0xb74c26 + 0x300 × turn]`, `exe::get_human_manager_record` → `human_manager_sheet::LIVE_MATCH`): if another of the 16 humans (the last 16 records of `G_STAFF_TABLE`, 110 bytes, `.classification()` active) watches the same one and it is his turn (`exe::screenmanager_find_manager_channel` on the manager), it leaves silently; otherwise it removes the turn from the four arrays of the summary (`day_match::SCOREBOARD`: `+5`/`+0x45`/`+0x85`/`+0xc5`, the counters from `match_spectators::IN_MATCH_COUNT`, +0x105..+0x108). \n Nobody else watching: it creates the engine (`day_match::ENGINE`, `0xf63b` bytes, `exe::new_cm3_match_engine` + `exe::cm3_match_engine_init_match`; without it error `0xa4b`), runs to the end (`exe::cm3_match_engine_run_match_steps` with −1; state `day_match::STATE`, 2 or 8 count in `[G_MATCH_DAY]` + `match_day_fields::FINISHED_COUNT`), except for 8 creates the summary (`day_match::SUMMARY`, `0xd7a` bytes with 2 objects of `0x625` at `match_record::HOME_TEAM`; without it error `0xa68`) and records it (`exe::match_stats_record_match`), frees the engine and takes the match off queue `G_VIRTUAL_STAFF` (`exe::virtual_staff_release_fixture`).

Finds in the fixture list the match of a statistics record (date, competition and club) and copies the fixture. Returns 1 if found. \n The fixture (`0x4f` bytes) of record `k` of the statistics index (`[stats]`, 12 bytes: `+0` competition, `+4` one of the clubs, `+8`/`match_stats_entry::YEAR` the date): it asks the schedule `G_FIXTURE_MANAGER` (`exe::fixture_manager_find_fixtures`) for the matches of that date and competition in a local list (`0x68d020`) and copies to `out` the first one with club `+4` at home (`fixture::HOME_CLUB_ID`) or away (`fixture::AWAY_CLUB_ID`). Index outside 0..`match_stats::CAPACITY` or null output: the original routine runs (error box, 0).

One step of the human's match on a network, by the clock and the humans' scoreboard (everyone sees each state; sounds, events, engine step, end, half time, goals, minute); records it and picks the day's human match. Returns 1 if it changed. \n One step of human match `p` on a network, by the clock (`exe::utils_get_time_ms`) and the humans' scoreboard (`day_match::SCOREBOARD`: `+0` state, `+1` event, `match_spectators::SEEN` who has already seen it, `match_spectators::IN_MATCH_COUNT` humans, `match_spectators::SEEN_COUNT` seen, `match_spectators::COUNT` pause, `+0x109` wait, `+0x10d` time, `+0x111` may advance, `+0x115` highlight). Without `p`, it moves the current one (`exe::match_day_step_background_match`) and starts the next (`exe::match_day_start_next_background_match`). \n It waits for everyone to see the state; then the sounds (`exe::match_events_is_line_finished`) and the time; it shows the next event (`exe::match_events_get_next_event`, highlight by table `exe::match_events_get_event_priority`) or takes one engine step (`exe::cm3_match_engine_run_match_steps` with 1) and sets the state: end (2/8), half time (4), goals on each side (`.score()`/`.score_side1()` against the summary), highlight, `.restart_type()`, the minute (`.clock()` / 11) against the summary (wait `0x226` - 50 x `match_record::SUB_TICK`); with a state, it records it (`exe::match_stats_fill_match_record`) and the day's human match (`match_day_fields::HUMAN_MATCH`) becomes the one with the highest competition (`exe::match_day_get_period_rank`) or the furthest along.

Each human confirms the network match; with all of them confirmed, creates the engine and prepares it for watching, or plays it to the end and records it. \n The current human (`G_SCREEN_MANAGER_CURRENT_SLOT`) confirms match `p` on a network (humans' scoreboard `day_match::SCOREBOARD`: `match_spectators::CONFIRMED` who confirmed, `match_spectators::IN_MATCH_COUNT` humans, `match_spectators::CONFIRMED_COUNT` confirmed). With all: it creates the engine (`exe::new_cm3_match_engine`) and prepares it for watching (`exe::cm3_match_engine_init_match` with the last argument 1). If it is not one to be watched (returns 0), it plays to the end (counting in `[G_MATCH_DAY]` + `match_day_fields::FINISHED_COUNT`), creates the summary, records it (`exe::match_stats_record_match`), frees the engine, takes it off the queue and sets `+0x119`; if it is, it notifies the commentator (`+0x8f7a` = 3), creates the summary, records it for watching (`exe::match_stats_fill_match_record`) and returns 1. Errors `0x4b8` (no match), `0x4d0`, `0x4ea`, `0x511` (out of memory).

`Media::process_transfer_interest()` (SEH frame without a destructor on the normal path), called by the daily routine (0x5cdd8f): drops transfer interest older than 31 days and, by chance, publishes the rumour linking the player to the interested clubs, with the transfer request, the AI manager response, the squad reaction and the rival warning; the AI owner may say he will not sell. \n For each interest record (25-byte vector at `media_fields::TRANSFER_INTERESTS`, count `media_fields::INTEREST_COUNT`: +0 player, `transfer_interest::CLUB` club, `transfer_interest::DATE` date, `transfer_interest::STATE` state, `transfer_interest::VALUE`, `transfer_interest::RATING`): expired (more than 31 days, `exe::date_add_days`), no manager at the owning club (the `club::MANAGER` of the club of the player's contract, kept from the previous iteration when he has no contract) or no player sheet: it leaves (the last one takes its place). Otherwise, if the club can reach the player (`exe::transfer_manager_can_club_bid_for_player`): state 0 and draw(25) zero give the rumour: the up to 5 clubs interested in him (records of the same player still at 0, marked 1; one already marked cancels), news item 0xfbc (`exe::new_newsitem`) with the player, the owner, the transfer request (below 15 in `.professionalism()` and `.loyalty()`, reputation above draw(12500) and `transfer_interest::RATING` above 12.5 × `.loyalty()` + 500: 0x24, otherwise draw(3)), `transfer_interest::VALUE`, the AI manager's response (`exe::media_pick_ai_manager_response`), the strengths (`exe::staff_get_player_strength_flags`), the position mask (`exe::formation_get_position_mask`), the owner's manager, the transfer list (`exe::staff_is_transfer_listed_or_requested`) and the interested clubs by reputation; to the humans (`player_news_recipients`: the interested ones and the humans of the same division, or of the same nation and up to 3000 below) (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`); with the request, the squad reaction (`exe::media_apply_squad_reaction_to_player_story`); with the response, the rival warning (`exe::media_warn_squad_of_position_rival`) and the reply to the story (`exe::media_apply_player_story_response`). \n In state 1, an AI owner, the record date after the player's `.date_joined_club()`, the contract without `contract::LEAVING_ON_BOSMAN` and off the list, happiness (`contract::HAPPINESS`) above draw(50) + 40 and draw(30) zero: the news that he will not sell (`exe::news_create_not_for_sale_story`) and his records go to 2. At the end, the vector is sorted (`exe::crt_qsort` with `compare_id_pair_keys`).

`news_create_not_for_sale_story(player, club, chairman, other)` (cdecl; media.cpp in the flow, european_cup.cpp in the map, with no other caller; SEH frame without a destructor on the normal path): news item 0xfbe that the club will not sell the player. \n With a player sheet and a club, news item 0xfbe (`exe::new_newsitem`) with the player, the other club (or −1), the club and a draw(3); the chairman, if he likes the player (`exe::staff_is_favoured_by`) or with draw(`.interference()` of his sheet) above draw(20), otherwise −1 in slot 7; reputation (`.world_reputation()` of the sheet) above 8000: to all managers (`exe::news_send_to_all_managers`), otherwise to the interested human managers (`player_news_recipients` with 0xd8, up to 30, `exe::news_send_to_club_manager`).

`Media::queue_trophy_praise_story(club, comp, mark)` (SEH frame without a destructor on the normal path), called by the title records (0x8693e2, 0x86b000): news item 0x2e with the board and fans praising the manager for the title. \n A club with a manager, a competition and outside national sides: news item 0x2e (`exe::new_newsitem`) with the manager, the club, the competition, a draw(2), the outlet (`exe::media_pick_outlet_type_for_club`), the pundit (`exe::punditlist_pick_random_pundit` with the nation or −1), the flag, the board confidence (+6 of the row in [`G_MANAGER_MANAGER`], or 5000), the club's league and the manager's days (`exe::date_days_since`); with 180 days or more, the club's reputation and the delivery to the manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`).

`media_format_response_option_label(kind, option, out, size)` (stdcall, ret 0x10): writes the label of a media story response option ("Deny rumour", "Defend Player", "No Comment"...) from the 22-case table by story kind into the output (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF`), for the stories screen (0x742b3b, with 0xde1f64 and 0x7d0). A null output or a size below 15: nothing.

`Media::process_transfer_squad_reactions(p, new, old, flag)`, at the end of each transfer (TRANSFER_MANAGER::move_player_to_club, 0x8ca879): the squad reactions to the transfer. Only for a player (`.player()`) aged 19 or more with reputation 4250. \n (A) The media story at the front of the queue (0xbd0, `story_log_entry::SUBTYPE` = 0x25, new club with id 0x25; never in practice): grievances in its person's contract. (B) In the new club's squad (50 slots `.squad()`), those who have been there more than `staff::PRESSURE` + 15 days (`FN_DATE_DAYS_SINCE` of `staff::DATE_JOINED_CLUB`) and have a contract: flag 0x800 with the same position turns into a grievance (`exe::staff_contract_apply_event_flags` 0x80000000) and draws; 0x400 is cleared with a strong squad (`exe::database_count_club_squad` up to the limit by reputation); with more than 2 in the position, the strong player may become a grievance or flag 0x200; grievance `grievances::STAR_TEAMMATE_SOLD` is cleared (`exe::staff_contract_clear_grievances`) when someone bigger arrives. A star signing (player's `.world_reputation()` above 6250): the supporters (+8 of the club's row in [[`G_MANAGER_MANAGER`]], +500 up to 10000) and the celebration (`queue_signing_celebration_story`); if something changed, draw(3) and the spokesman celebrate. \n (C) In the old club's squad (with a league), with the club's strength and reputation (or the nation among the seven `KEY_NATION_GREECE`, `KEY_NATION_SWEDEN`, `KEY_NATION_WALES`, `KEY_NATION_FINLAND`, `KEY_NATION_REPUBLIC_OF_IRELAND`, `KEY_NATION_NORTHERN_IRELAND`, `KEY_NATION_AUSTRALIA`): grievances 0x40000000 / 0x20000000 at the team mate leaving, morale (`contract::MORALE`) −25, flag 0x400, flags 0x200/0x800 and grievance `grievances::SAME_POSITION_SIGNING` cleared; if something changed and the player was a star, the unsettled team mate (`exe::media_queue_sale_unrest_story`).

`Media::queue_signing_celebration_story(p, club, kind, a, porta_voz)` (SEH frame for the local news item), called by the transfer reactions (`process_transfer_squad_reactions`): news item 0xbe5 of the fans or a squad spokesman celebrating the signing, to the club manager. \n A player with `.nation()`, a current club (`.club_job()`) with a manager (`.manager()`) and `.stadium()`, a player sheet (`.player()`); type 2 without a spokesman: nothing. The news item 0xbe5: the player (id and the three keys), his club's id, draw(2), the outlet (`exe::media_pick_outlet_type_for_person`), the pundit (`exe::punditlist_pick_random_pundit` with the club, the outlet and the nation `.nation()` or −1), the position mask (`exe::formation_get_position_mask`), the type, the computer manager's response (`exe::media_pick_ai_manager_response` with 0x82; 0 with a human manager), for type 2 the spokesman (id and keys), the club's reputation above 7250, the manager (id and keys) and `a`; it goes to the manager of the player's club (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`).

`Media::queue_sale_unrest_story(old, new, p, comp)` (SEH frame for the local news item), called by the transfer reactions (`process_transfer_squad_reactions`): news item 0xbe4 of the team mate unhappy at the sale, to the old club's manager. \n An old club with a manager (`.manager()`), not a national side (`is_national_team`), a team mate and a player with a player sheet (`.player()`). The news item 0xbe4: the manager, the team mate and the player (id and the three keys of each), the ids of the two clubs, draw(2) (+2 if the team mate's `.professionalism()` is not above draw(5) + 10), the outlet (`exe::media_pick_outlet_type_for_club`), the pundit (`exe::punditlist_pick_random_pundit` with the nation `.nation()` or −1) and 2; it goes to the old club's manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`).

`media_pick_outlet_type_for_person(person)` (cdecl): picks the media outlet type like the club version does, but from the player's reputation (`.current_reputation()` of the player sheet `.player()`). \n Used by the player's stories (`exe::media_create_player_media_story`): the outburst, the praise, wanting to play, and the signing celebration (`queue_signing_celebration_story`, in transfers).

`Media::adjust_supporter_confidence(club, sujeito, topic, target, variant)` (SEH frame without a destructor): adds the change to the supporters' confidence (+8 of the club's row in [[0xb67a44]], kept between 1 and 10000): the target minus the current confidence, × 0.75, damped by a favoured or rejected manager and beyond ±1000 (see `fan_confidence_change`). \n Beyond ±500, news item 0xbe0 (local) to the club's manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`): 0 = 0, 1 = topic, 2 = variant, 3 = draw(4), 4 = club id, 5 = the degree (5 below −750, 4 negative, 3 up to 750, 2 above), 6..9 the manager; with a `sujeito`, 10..13 the `sujeito` and 14 = 6 favoured, 7 rejected, 8 neither; then −1, the new confidence and 0.

`Media::adjust_board_confidence(club, sujeito, topic, target, variant, sexto)` (SEH frame without a destructor): adds the change to the board's confidence (+6 of the club's row, kept between 1 and 10000): (confidence − 6000)/20 + target, × 0.75, damped by a chairman who likes or dislikes the manager and beyond ±1000 (see `board_confidence_change`). \n Beyond ±500, news item 0xbe0 (local) to the club's manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`): 0 = 1, 1 = topic, 2 = variant, 3 = draw(4), 4 = club id, 5 = the degree (5 below −750 with confidence below 4500; 9 when negative with confidence above 6250, otherwise 4; 2 above 750 with confidence above 6250, otherwise 3), 6..9 the manager; with a `sujeito` 10..13 and 14 = 6/7/8 (the chairman likes, dislikes, neither); then the chairman (or −1), the new confidence, the `sexto` (with it 1 and the word `board_record::EXPECTATION_FLAGS`), and the `sujeito`'s flags: contract `.squad_status()` 0x10/0x20 above 25 years old, average rating above the league average × 5, `.loyalty()` and `.professionalism()` above 14, more than 1500 days at the club, value (`FN_CONTRACT_MANAGER_CALC_PLAYER_VALUE`) above 4,500,000 and reputation (+5 of the sheet) above 140.

`Media::queue_player_gratitude_news(player, club, kind, variant)` (SEH frame without a destructor): posts news item 0xbda of the player's gratitude to the manager. \n With a player with a sheet (`.player()`), a club with a manager (`.manager()`) and his contract with the club (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`), news item 0xbda (local) to the manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`): 0..3 the player (3 = −1 without +0xc), 4 = club id, 5 = the type, 6 = the variant, 7 = the type's draw, 8..0xb the manager, 0xc = 0x420e9, 0xd..0x10 the assistant (`.assistant_manager()`) or −1. The type: if the player is on the media list (this +0/`media_fields::STORY_LOG_COUNT`, 0x17 bytes, id at `story_log_entry::PERSON_A` and flag 2 at `story_log_entry::RESPONSE`) or the contract has 0x2000 or 8 in `contract::GRIEVANCES`, types 0, 2, 4, 7, 9, 0xe and 0x23 become 0x12 (`.temperament()` ≥ draw(10)) or 0x21; injured (`exe::injury_get_player_injury`): 0xc. For types 0, 6, 14 and 17: with the sheet's `.work_rate()` below 10, draw(3) + 2; otherwise draw(5), and 0 or 1 raises the sheet's `player_sheet::WORK_RATE` (up to 20).

`Media::post_player_backing_request_news(player, club, kind, quarto)` (SEH frame without a destructor): for a human club, posts news item 0xbcf of the player asking for backing to the manager. \n With a player with a sheet (`.player()`) and a human club (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`), news item 0xbcf (local) to the club's manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`): 0..3 the player (3 = −1 without +0xc), 4 = club id, 5/6 = (1, ·) with reputation (`.current_reputation()` of the sheet) above 4250, otherwise (2, ·): the second is 1 if (`.ambition()` > 15 and `.temperament()` < 6, or `.professionalism()` < 10 and `.loyalty()` < 6 in the lower band), 3 if the type is 0x20, 1 or 0x1e with `.loyalty()` > 15, `.professionalism()` > 10 and more than 210 days at the club, otherwise 2; 7 = type, 8 = `quarto`, 9 = transfer listed (`exe::staff_is_transfer_listed_or_requested`).

`Media::post_player_criticism_reaction_news(player, club, topic, reply)` (SEH frame without a destructor): posts news item 0xbdc of the player's reaction to criticism, delivered to the managers of the interested clubs. \n With a player with a sheet, a club with a manager and the contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`), news item 0xbdc (local): 0..3 the player, 4 = club id, 5 = the reaction (with reputation above 4250 and above the club's, category `exe::contract_manager_get_deserved_squad_status` 1 or 2 and more than 22 years old: 1 or 3 if `.loyalty()` < 10, `.ambition()` > 15 and `.temperament()` < 6; 2 or 4 with more than 1000 days, `.loyalty()` > 15 and without 0x181 in the contract's `contract::GRIEVANCES`; the higher one when the contract has 0x2000 or 8, `.professionalism()` < 10, `.temperament()` > 10, `.loyalty()` < 15, more than 23 years old and the `reply` is 2; otherwise 0), 6 = `reply`, 7 = board confidence below 4000, 8 = topic, 9..0xc the manager. It goes to the managers of the clubs that `exe::transfer_manager_collect_player_news_recipients` ([0xde1f54], 0x21a, up to 30) returns.

`Media::rate_player_form_for_story(player, club, contract, kind, mode, weight)`: the player's rating (x87, in st0) for a media story kind. \n Without a contract, the player's contract with the club (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`); without any, 0. Base: the league's average rating x (`G_PLAYER_STATS` `player_stats_fields::RATING_SUM` / `player_stats_fields::RATED_COUNT`, without games 6.8), the player's statistics (`exe::playerstats_get_stat`, category 6: s1 field 1, s2 field 0x11, s3 field 2, default 6.5) and the average of the ratings (`exe::playerstats_get_recent_form`) × 0.2: r = (s2 − x) + (average − x) − weight/60; with s1 < 12, r × s1/12; when negative, × the ratio of the reputations. Then, by type (0..0x52), additions from the contract type (`contract::SQUAD_STATUS` >> 4), the age, the days at the club (`exe::date_days_since`), attributes of the record `.player()` and the weight; type 0x52 gives r × 0.75 + s3/max(s1, 1) − 0.4.

`Media::write_financial_trouble_news_text(news, body, out)`: writes the headline or body of the club-in-financial-trouble story, by severity, with the club name linked. \n It reads fields 0 (the club), 1 (the severity) and 2 of the news item (`exe::newsitem_get_slot`), builds the text in 0xde1f64 (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF`) by severity (> 0x1a5e, > 0xcb2 in the body; > 0x1a5e in the headline) with the club's name (`club::SHORT_NAME`) and gender (`.short_gender_name()`), puts it into `out` (`exe::text_set_string`) and links the name to the club (`exe::text_add_link`, type 0x7d5).

`Media::log_story(a, b, kind, subtype, reply)`: appends a story to the story log and sorts it again. \n Appends to the story log ([this], capacity `media_fields::STORY_LOG_CAPACITY`, count `media_fields::STORY_LOG_COUNT`; 23-byte records) today's date (+0, `copy_record_date` from `G_CURRENT_DATE`), the id of `a` (+8) and of `b` (`story_log_entry::PERSON_B`) (−1 without them), the `kind` (`story_log_entry::TYPE`), the `subtype` (signed byte, as a word at `story_log_entry::SUBTYPE`) and the `reply` (`story_log_entry::RESPONSE`); the count goes up and the log is re-sorted (`sort_news_log`: qsort `exe::crt_qsort` with `compare_story_log_records`). Without a log, it allocates 20 (`exe::crt_malloc`; without memory, box 0x6e11 and the end); when full, it grows by 20 (realloc `exe::crt_realloc`; box 0x6e1c).

`Media::expire_story_log()`: removes the stories older than the limit, moving the last one into the gap, then sorts again. \n Each story in the log older than the limit (today − 100 days; the team one, `story_log_entry::TYPE` 0xbdf, today − (40 + draw(40)), one draw `exe::utils_random` per such story on each pass; dates from `exe::date_sub_days` over `G_CURRENT_DATE`) is overwritten by the last one (23 bytes), the count (`media_fields::STORY_LOG_COUNT`) goes down and the same place is looked at again. If any are left, it re-sorts (`sort_news_log`: qsort with `compare_story_log_records`). Without a log, nothing.

`Media::has_logged_story(a, b, kind, subtype, desde)`: tells whether a story is in the log. \n The team story (type 0xbdf): a linear search for one of `story_log_entry::TYPE` 0xbdf with the id of `b` (`story_log_entry::PERSON_B`) and the `subtype` (word `story_log_entry::SUBTYPE`), without looking at `a` or the date: 1 if found. The others: a binary search (bsearch `exe::crt_bsearch` with `compare_story_log_records`) by the key {id of `a` or −1, id of `b`, kind, subtype} (the default date `exe::date_date_54a110` in the key, which the comparison does not read); found and without `desde`, 1; with `desde`, 1 if the story is not older than it. Otherwise 0. `b` cannot be null (the original reads it without checking).

`Media::add_transfer_interest(player, club, value, rating)`: if the {player, club} key is missing, appends the interest and sorts again. \n With the interest vector (`media_fields::TRANSFER_INTERESTS`, capacity `media_fields::INTEREST_CAPACITY`, count `media_fields::INTEREST_COUNT`; 25-byte records), it searches (`has_interest`: bsearch `exe::crt_bsearch` with `compare_id_pair_keys`) for the key {player id, club id or −1}: already there, nothing. Otherwise it appends: player id (+0), club id (+4, read without checking), today's date (+8, `copy_record_date` from `G_CURRENT_DATE`), 0 (`transfer_interest::STATE`, the rumour has not come out yet), the `value` up to 50,000,000 (`transfer_interest::VALUE`) and the `rating` × 100 truncated (`transfer_interest::RATING`, _ftol 0x945640); the count goes up and it re-sorts (qsort with `compare_id_pair_keys`). Without a vector, it allocates 20 (`exe::crt_malloc`; without memory, box 0x665d and the end); when full, it grows by 20 (realloc `exe::crt_realloc`; box 0x6668). The key's default date (`exe::date_date_54a110`) is on the stack, as in the original.

`compare_story_log_records(a, b)` (cdecl): the qsort and bsearch comparison of the story log. \n Null first (`a` null −1, `b` null 1); by subject a (+8), subject b (+0xc) and type (+0x13), the difference of the first one that differs; when equal, the difference of the subtypes (signed words `story_log_entry::SUBTYPE`).

`Media::remove_transfer_interest(person)`: removes the person's interests, moving the last one into the gap, then sorts again. \n In the interest vector (`media_fields::TRANSFER_INTERESTS`, `media_fields::INTEREST_COUNT` records of 25 bytes), each one of the person (+0 = id) is overwritten by the last one (6 dwords and a byte), the count goes down and the same place is looked at again. If any are left, it re-sorts (qsort `media_crt_qsort` with `compare_id_pair_keys`).

`media_queue_player_apology_news(player, club, historia)` (stdcall, ret 0xc; SEH frame without a destructor), called by the story effects (0x736c00) and the reply to the player's story (`exe::media_apply_player_story_response`): builds news item 0xbdb and sends it to the club's manager. \n With the player, the sheet (`.player()`) and the club, news item 0xbdb in a local (`exe::new_newsitem` with 0) with the data 0 = id, 1 to 3 = the names (`names::ID` of `.first_name()`, `.second_name()` and `.common_name()`; without the third, −1), 4 = club id, 5 = the story (`historia`), 6 = 0 and 7 = the variant: draw(4) for stories 0, 2 to 5, 13, 14, 17 and 35 (table 0x72bd2c), otherwise 0; it goes to the club's manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`).

Draws a former international as the pundit for `club` (or to talk about `subject`), weighted by nation reputation and caps (`this` is not read). \n 150 rounds; in each it draws people (`exe::utils_random` with `G_STAFF_COUNT`, 110 bytes in `G_STAFF_TABLE`) until it finds one aged (`staff::AGE`) ≥ 37, with national team caps (`staff::INT_APPS`) ≥ 50, a sheet (`staff::NON_PLAYER`), no club (`staff::CLUB_JOB`) if he has a contract (`staff::PLAYER`) and who is not the club's manager (`.manager()`); the 100th try ends the round. The weight is a draw of the nation's reputation (`staff::NATION`, `.reputation()`) × caps, doubled if he is from the subject's nation (without a subject: he must be from the club's nation, `.nation()`). From another nation: the reputation must beat 6500 + a draw of 100, the sheet's `non_player::WORLD_REPUTATION` ≥ 6000 and the subject must not dislike him (`exe::staff_is_disliked_by`). The one with the highest weight is kept (the first accepted always gets in). Without a club and without a subject: 0.

`Media::pick_ai_manager_response(manager, player, kind)` (3.7 KB): the computer manager's response (1, 2 or 3) to a story of the given type about the player. \n Without a manager, without the manager sheet (`.non_player()`), a player without a sheet (`.player()`), the manager himself, without a club (`.club_job()`, otherwise the national side `.national_job()`) or without the player's contract with it (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`): 3. The rating is trunc(5 × `exe::media_rate_player_form_for_story`(player, club, contract, kind, 3, 0)); without a player, the argument's word stays in its place (the manager pointer, as in the original). Then, by type: 0x83 by the contract type and the knowledge (`exe::non_player_attribute_rating`); 0x82 by the manager's likes and dislikes (`exe::staff_is_disliked_by`/`exe::staff_is_favoured_by`) and draws; 0x1f by the transfer list (`exe::staff_is_transfer_listed_or_requested`) and the contract; the others, first, by the likes and dislikes with the rating, and then by families of types, each with its own chain of draws (`exe::utils_random`); 8/0x25 and 3/4 can put the player on the manager's rejected list (`exe::staff_add_disliked_staff`).

`Media::post_financial_trouble_news(club)` (SEH frame without a destructor): posts news item 0x1790 of the club in financial trouble to the managers of the nation, or to all for a big club. \n With the club, the nation (`.nation()`), the sheet (`.stadium()`, with `player_sheet::PENALTIES`) and the division (`.division()`), it builds news item 0x1790 in a local (`exe::new_newsitem` with 0) with the data 0 = club id, 1 = reputation (`.reputation()`) and 2 = draw(2) (`exe::utils_random`); a club with reputation 9000 or more in a division with `.reputation()` above 12: to all managers (`exe::news_send_to_all_managers`); otherwise to those of the nation (`exe::news_send_to_nation_managers`). The local news item is 0xe0 bytes (the delivery copies only up to +0xde).

`Media::pick_rival_manager_id(club)`: returns the id of the manager of a rival of the same league and much bigger, or of a drawn club in a league clash, who passes the draws; or −1. \n With a manager (`.manager()`) with a contract (`.non_player()`) and a league (`.division()`; without a league, only a national side, `exe::database_is_national_team`): the first of the manager's rejected list (`exe::staff_get_disliked_staff`) with a manager record and rating (`non_player::CURRENT_REPUTATION`) + 750 < rating (never: the draw(3) there does not happen); then each rival (+0xb3, +0xb7, +0xbb) with a manager who passes the draws, of the same league and with reputation (`.reputation()`) above the club's + 750, with draw(3) ≠ 0; then up to 50 drawn clubs (from `G_CLUB_COUNT` − 2 × `G_NATION_COUNT`) that make a league clash (`FN_COMP_UTIL_GET_LEAGUE_CLASH_TYPE`, with the draw limit as 3rd argument, a leftover on the original's stack) with a manager who passes the draws. Returns the manager's id, or −1.

`Media::queue_manager_fa_complaint_story(club, person, kind, a, b, c)` (SEH for the local news item, no destructor), called by discipline (0x55e300) and by MANAGER_MANAGER (`exe::manager_manager_handle_fa_request`, 0x6ab800): posts news item 0x178e of the manager's complaint to the FA. \n A club with a nation (`.nation()`) and a manager (`.manager()`), and a person: news item 0x178e (the club; the manager, id and keys, or −1; the type; the person, id and keys; a; b; the nation or −1; c) to the nation's managers (`exe::news_send_to_nation_managers`) if the reputation (`.reputation()`) is above 4750, otherwise to the club (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`).

Picks a random pundit: type 1 on Sunday becomes 7; local types (2, 4): the club's pundits; the others: of the type and nation (−1 any); up to 20, random(n) and the id, or −1. \n Ret 0xc; 0x1094-byte frame through 0x945610: `PunditList::pick_random_pundit(club, kind, nation)`, from the press stories (`exe::media_create_player_media_story`, 0x733a60) and from the news texts. Type 1 on Sunday (`exe::date_get_weekday` = 6) becomes 7. Types 2 and 4 (local): those of list `[this+4]` whose `pundit::CITY_ID` is the id of the city of the club's `.stadium()` (`.city()`) (none: −1); the others: those of list `[this]` of the type (`pundit::MEDIA_TYPE`) and the nation (`pundit::NATION_ID`; −1 accepts any). Up to 20; none: −1; otherwise the id (word +0, signed) of one of them by random(n).

Returns the name (+2) and flag (`pundit::GENDER`) of the pundit with the id, or the default outlet type name and flag 0. \n Ret 0x10: `PunditList::get_pundit_name(kind, id, name, mark)`, from the news texts. Without `name`: flag 0. Id −1: the type's default name and flag 0. Otherwise the pundit with the id (word +0) in list `[this+4]` (types 2 and 4) or `[this]`: the name (+2, sprintf "%s" `FN_CRT_SPRINTF`) and the flag (`pundit::GENDER`); without him, the default name and flag 0.

Fills the match record as seen by the club: date, fixture id, competition, venue, club, opponent and goals for and against (the extra-time score, if any). \n `fill_match_record_from_fixture(game, club, out)`, from the tactic statistics (`record_tactic_result`, at the end of each match without a human) and from the records. Null match, club or output: the box (lines 0x29, 0x31, 0x39) and 0. Otherwise the date (+0, `exe::date_operator_3d` of the Date(day `.day()`, year `.year()`) from `exe::new_date`), +8 the match id (+0), `club_match_record::ROUND_PREFIX` word `.round_prefix()`, `club_match_record::ROUND_NAME` word `.round_name()`, `club_match_record::VENUE` the side (`exe::comp_util_get_fixture_venue_side`, cdecl(club, match)), `club_match_record::CLUB_ID` the club id, `club_match_record::MATCH_STATS_SLOT` the match's `.match_stats_slot()`; home side (`.home_club()`): `club_match_record::OPPONENT_ID` the match's `.away_club_id()` and the score (`club_match_record::GOALS_FOR` for, `club_match_record::GOALS_AGAINST` against) from the extra-time one (`.home_goals_extra_time()`/`.away_goals_extra_time()`) if it is not negative, otherwise the normal one (`.home_goals()`/`.away_goals()`); away side: `club_match_record::OPPONENT_ID` the `.home_club_id()` and the score reversed. Returns 1.

Stores the three name ids (−1 when missing), the person's id and birth date in a compact reference. \n `fill_staff_name_ref(person, out)`, from the club and competition records, the suspension news, the award and the player search. Null person or output: the box (lines 0x80, 0x88) and 0. Otherwise +0, +4, +8 the name ids (`staff::FIRST_NAME` and the two after it; −1 with no name), `record_holder::STAFF_ID` the person's id and `record_holder::DATE` the birth date (`staff::DATE_OF_BIRTH`, `exe::date_operator_3d`); returns 1.

Returns the result code of the record: 3 win, 2 score draw, 1 goalless draw, −3 defeat. \n `match_record_result_code(record)`, from the competition statistics (`exe::comp_stats_record_match_result`, on each match). Null record: the box (line 0x25a) and 0. For (`club_match_record::GOALS_FOR`) > against (`club_match_record::GOALS_AGAINST`), signed: 3; draw with goals: 2; goalless draw: 1; defeat: −3 (only the byte counts: the caller reads al).

Tells whether the match record is a win by a larger margin than the other one, or the same margin with more goals scored. \n `match_record_is_bigger_win(a, b)`, from the club records after each match (0x444930) and from the competition ones (0x49fb93): 1 if `a` is a win (goals `club_match_record::GOALS_FOR` > `club_match_record::GOALS_AGAINST`, signed bytes) by a larger margin than that of `b`, or equal with more goals scored. Null record: the original routine ("Error" box, 0).

Tells whether the match record is a defeat by a larger margin than the other one, or the same margin with more goals conceded. \n `match_record_is_bigger_defeat(a, b)`, from the club records after each match (0x444930): 1 if `a` is a defeat (`club_match_record::GOALS_FOR` < `club_match_record::GOALS_AGAINST`) by a larger margin than that of `b`, or equal with more goals conceded. Null record: the original routine ("Error" box, 0).

The scout manager's daily update, on day slice 2: prunes the scouting requests (non-human club, player already at the club, older than a year, 3 reports, injured); a request older than 30 days becomes up to 3 reports from the manager's scouts covering the player's nation and leaves; then the reports, the request order and one search tick on every human manager list. \n Ret 0; SEH frame for the local list and the dates: `SCOUT_MANAGER::daily_update()`, from the day (only on slice 2 of the day, `G_CURRENT_DAY_SLICE`; otherwise 0). Prunes the scouting requests (`scout_manager_fields::SCOUT_REQUESTS`, count `scout_manager_fields::SCOUT_REQUEST_COUNT`, 0x11 bytes; the removed one gets the last one), and the processed request becomes up to 3 reports from the scouts of the club's manager (of the 10 lists, `exe::scout_manager_get_search`, the one that covers the player's nation, `exe::player_search_scout_covers_nation`): `exe::player_search_report_on_player` with −1000, mode 1, and the record (0x67 bytes) goes into the local list if byte `scout_report::REPORT_MODE` ended ≥ 0. Then the reports (`exe::scout_manager_send_scout_reports`), the request order (`exe::crt_qsort` with 0x7fc270) and one search (`exe::player_search_run_scout_day`) on each of the 10 lists of the human managers (the last 16 persons with `.classification()` = 1). Returns 1.

Copies the list records into an array, sorts it and sends one news item per run of the same player and club. \n Ret 4: `SCOUT_MANAGER::send_scout_reports(list)`, from the scouts' day (`scout_manager_daily_update`) and from the search (`scout_manager_scout_match`). With the list not empty (+0 count): a vector of count × 0x67 (`exe::crt_malloc`; out of memory, the box at line 0x7dd) with copies of the records, sorted (`exe::crt_qsort` with 0x7fc2a0); each consecutive group of the same player (`scout_report::PLAYER_ID`) and the same club (`scout_report::CLUB_ID`) becomes a report news item (`exe::scout_manager_send_scout_report_news` with the first one and how many). Frees the vector (`exe::crt_free`). The list is left with its cursor at the start.

Sends the 0x138e news item with up to 3 records, the scout, the match and the player's strengths for the club, to the club's manager. \n Ret 8; SEH frame for the local news item: `SCOUT_MANAGER::send_scout_report_news(r, how_many)`, from the reports (`send_scout_reports`). News 0x138e (`exe::new_newsitem`): count (up to 3), `scout_report::REPORT_MODE`, the scout (`exe::write_staff_name_ref_to_news` with `scout_report::PLAYER_NAME_REF`), `scout_report::PLAYER_AGE`, `scout_report::POSITION_MASK`, club `scout_report::CLUB_ID`, the match data (`FN_WRITE_MATCH_RECORD_TO_NEWS`), `scout_report::HAS_MATCH`, `scout_report::LEAGUE_MATCH`, `scout_report::ELIGIBILITY_NOTE`, `scout_report::WORK_PERMIT_GRANTED`, from each of the records (`scout_report::SCOUT_NAME_REF` + 0x67 × k) +0xc, +0, +4, +8 and +0x26 + 8 × +0x25, 0x420e9 and the player's (`scout_report::PLAYER_ID`) strengths for the club (`exe::staff_get_player_strength_flags`); goes to the club's manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`).

Tells whether the current search of the current human manager session has no club (+0x191 = −2). \n Ret 0: `SCOUT_MANAGER::current_search_has_no_club()`, from the search screens (0x482a9b). The session of the human manager whose turn it is (`[this + scout_manager_fields::EDIT_SESSIONS + 4 × index]`): the current search (the signed byte at +0 of the session) without a club (+0x191 = −2). No manager or no session: 0; index out of range: the box (line 0x454; the original) and 0.

The scouts at the match: for each human manager, the 10 scouts in a randomly drawn order; one for the playing club starts the assignment, and each watches the match; at the end the reports go out. \n Ret 8; SEH frame for the local LLIST `exe::new_llist`/`exe::drop_llist`: `SCOUT_MANAGER::scout_match(p, result)`, from the closing of the day's match (`close_day_match`, Rust). For each of the last 16 person records (`G_STAFF_TABLE`, 0x6e bytes, from the last backwards) with `.classification()` = 1 (the human manager): in a zeroed vector of 10 marks (`exe::crt_calloc`), the 10 scouts in a random order (`exe::utils_random` of 10 until an unmarked one is found); each one's record (`exe::scout_manager_get_search`) with `player_search_fields::ASSIGNED_OPPONENT`, in a fixture with flags `.home_side_mark()` and `.away_side_mark()` and of the manager's club (`.club_job()` = `.home_club()` or `.away_club()` of the fixture), starts the scouting (`exe::player_search_start_scout_assignment` with −1, −1, −1, 0, 1); and watches the match (`exe::player_search_scout_match`, the reports into the local list). The vector is freed (`exe::crt_free`). Finally the reports go out (`exe::scout_manager_send_scout_reports`) and the list is destroyed. Returns 1.

Returns the human manager's searches edit session. \n Ret 4: `SCOUT_MANAGER::get_edit_session(manager)`, from building the search's known players (0x7afeb7). The human manager's edit session (`scout_manager_fields::EDIT_SESSIONS` + 4 × index). No manager or index out of range: the box (lines 0xde and 0xe8; the original) and 0.

Stores the human manager's searches edit session and returns 1. \n Ret 8: `SCOUT_MANAGER::set_edit_session(sessao, manager)`, from the search screens (0x8085bc, 0x812d88...). Writes the session into `scout_manager_fields::EDIT_SESSIONS` + 4 × the manager's index and returns 1. No manager or index out of range: the box (lines 0xb8 and 0xc2; the original) and 0.

Returns the list selected by the human manager (null: the current one). \n Ret 4: `SCOUT_MANAGER::get_selected_list(manager)`, from the search screens (0x804248). The list chosen by the human manager (byte at `scout_manager_fields::SELECTED_LISTS` + index). No manager or outside 0..15: the original routine ("Error" box, 0xff).

Stores the list selected by the human manager (null: the current one). \n Ret 8: `SCOUT_MANAGER::set_selected_list(list, manager)`, from the search screens (0x804460). Writes the chosen list (byte) into `scout_manager_fields::SELECTED_LISTS` + the human manager's index and returns 1. No manager or outside 0..15: the original routine ("Error" box, 0).

Tells whether the fixture has a watched club or an available player with a scout request (at the club or national side, not loaned out, injured, suspended or barred, and not yet played). \n Ret 4: `SCOUT_MANAGER::fixture_has_scouted_player(fixture)` (from match_without_human `exe::match_day_can_quick_simulate`): negative competition (+0), 0. A club of the watched list (static LLIST `G_SCOUT_CLUB_TABLE_LIST`, cursor reset; +0 of the item) equal to `.home_club_id()` or `.away_club_id()` of the fixture, 1. Then the scouting requests (`scout_manager_fields::SCOUT_REQUESTS`, 0x11 bytes, the person at +4, count `scout_manager_fields::SCOUT_REQUEST_COUNT`, reread on each step): a person whose club (`.club_job()`) or national side (`.national_job()`) is one of the two in the fixture (`.home_club()` first, then `.away_club()`), who is not loaned out (`exe::transfer_manager_player_needs_work_permit`, outside a national side `exe::database_is_national_team`), nor injured (`exe::injury_get_player_injury_status` = 2), nor suspended (`exe::discipline_is_player_banned`), nor barred (`exe::nationalteams_get_international_duty_club`), and who has not played yet (`exe::transfer_manager_get_ineligibility_code` = 0), gives 1. Otherwise 0.

Tells whether the player is on the human's scouting shortlist (through the open edit session or the first type 1 search). \n Ret 8: `SCOUT_MANAGER::is_player_shortlisted(person, manager)` (from the interested clubs `collect_interested_clubs`, from the status `shortlist_manager_estimate_squad_status`, from `is_player_under_offer` and from screens): null person, the "Error" box (line 0x231) and 0; without a manager, that of the human whose turn it is (without him, the box at line 0x23b and 0). The human's slot (byte +0 of the manager − byte of `G_STAFF_COUNT` + 16, signed, 0..15): with the edit session open (`[this + slot × 4 + scout_manager_fields::EDIT_SESSIONS]`), its answer (`exe::searcheditsession_is_player_on_short_list`); otherwise the first of the 10 searches (`exe::scout_manager_get_search`) of type 1 (`player_search_fields::LIST_TYPE`) answers (`exe::player_search_contains_player`). Without it, 0.

Returns the human manager's scouting record 0..9 (0x2b0 bytes). \n Ret 8: scouting record `which` 0..9 of human manager `manager` (without him, the one whose turn it is in `[0xb74c26 + 0x300 × G_SCREEN_MANAGER_CURRENT_SLOT]`): the index (id − `G_STAFF_COUNT` + 16) × 10 + `which`, up to `[t+8]` − 1, with 0x2b0 bytes each starting at `[t]`. `which` out of range, no manager or index out of range: the original routine (error box).

Empties the list and adds the person of each scout request of the club; returns whether there is any. \n Ret 8: `SCOUT_MANAGER::collect_club_scout_targets(club, list)`: with `list`, empties it (`exe::llist_clear`) and adds (`exe::llist_add_tail`, 0x6e bytes) the person of each scouting request of club `*club`. Returns whether there is any. Null club: 0 (the list stays empty).

Removes a scout request: finds the request (club, person; 17 bytes), pulls the next ones up and sorts again (0x7fc270); null club = the current human manager's club. \n Ret 8: `SCOUT_MANAGER::remove_scout_request(person, club)`: a null club is that of the current human manager (`[0xb74c26 + 0x300 × G_SCREEN_MANAGER_CURRENT_SLOT]`, `.club_job()`; without him, nothing). With the person, searches (bsearch `crt_bsearch` with 0x7fc270, which reads only +0 club and +4 person; the key's default date at +8, byte `scout_request::REPORT_COUNT` has no value and the copy uses zero) for the request in the vector (`scout_manager_fields::SCOUT_REQUESTS`, `scout_manager_fields::SCOUT_REQUEST_COUNT` records of 17 bytes); found: pulls the following ones up one place (+0, +4, the date +8 through `exe::date_operator_3d` and byte `scout_request::REPORT_COUNT`), the count goes down and, if any remain, sorts again (qsort `media_crt_qsort`).

Tells whether the club can scout the nation: a poor (balance < 1,000,000) and small (reputation < 5000) club outside the nation's region: 0; else 1. \n Ret 8; `this` is not read: `SCOUT_MANAGER::can_club_scout_nation(nation, club)`: the club (or that of the human whose turn it is) does not cover the nation only if it has finances (`exe::financetable_get_club_finance` on `G_FINANCE_TABLE`) with a 64-bit balance below 1,000,000, reputation (`.reputation()`) below 5000 and the region (`.actual_region()`) of its nation (`.nation()`) different from the region of `nation`: 0. Otherwise 1. No club at all: the original routine ("Error" box and 0).

Removes from the manager's scout lists the scouts no longer at the club and gives each club scout without a list the first free list; with the edit session open, it refreshes the scouts. \n Ret 4: `SCOUT_MANAGER::sync_scout_lists(manager)`, when the staff of the human club changes (leaving the post `remove_staff_from_club` and the scouts' vacancy, staff transfers and signings). Without a manager, the human whose turn it is; without him, the box at line 0x1ba and 0. Of the manager's 10 searches, the scout lists (`player_search_fields::LIST_TYPE` = 4) whose scout (`search_scout`) is no longer a scout (`.job_for_club()` = `job_kind::SCOUT`) of the manager's club (`.club_job()`) are left without a scout (`set_search_scout` with 0; without a club, all of them; with a club, those without a scout stay as they are). With a club, each of the club's 7 scouts (`exe::database_get_club_scouts`) that has no list goes to the first scout list without a scout. Then the manager's slot (byte +0 − byte of `G_STAFF_COUNT` + 16, 0..15; out of range, the box at line 0x212 and 0): with the edit session open (`[this + slot × 4 + scout_manager_fields::EDIT_SESSIONS]`), it redoes the lists' scouts (`exe::searcheditsession_refresh_scout_assignments`). Returns 1.

Returns the player's slot in the record of the human's search that scouts his club, or 0. \n Ret 4: `SCOUT_MANAGER::find_club_search_entry(p)`, from the person and search screens (0x808540, 0x813210, 0x870650, 0x87a510): without the human whose turn it is or without the person's club (`.club_job()`), 0. The human's slot (byte +0 − byte of `G_STAFF_COUNT` + 16, 0..15; out of range, the box at line 0x4b5 and 0). The first of the 10 searches (`exe::scout_manager_get_search`) with the scouted club (`player_search_fields::ASSIGNED_CLUB`) equal to the person's and its record (`player_search_fields::SCOUTED_CLUB_RECORD`) gives the person's slot in it (`exe::player_search_find_or_claim_player_slot` without reserving); none, 0.

Writes the translated scout list name: Short List, Player Search, Staff Search or Scout #n. \n `scout_manager_write_list_name(index, text, size)`, from the SCOUT_MANAGER constructor (0x7f6760) and from the search screens. The translated name (`FN_LANGLIB_SPRINTF`) of list `index`: 0 "Short List", 1 "Player Search", 2 "Staff Search", 3..9 "Scout #<%d - number>" with `index` − 2. Returns 1. Index outside 0..9, null text or size below 50: the original routine ("Error" box, 0).

Tells whether the club (or the current human's) asked to scout the player, with fewer than 3 reports and, if asked, with the date already due. \n Ret 0xc: `SCOUT_MANAGER::has_scout_request(player, club, so_vencidos)`: whether the club (null: that of the human whose turn it is, `[G_SCREEN_RECORDS_MANAGER + 0x300 × G_SCREEN_MANAGER_CURRENT_SLOT]` `staff::CLUB_JOB`) asked for the player to be scouted: binary search (`FN_CRT_BSEARCH` with 0x7fc270) by the pair (club id, player id) in the requests (`scout_manager_fields::SCOUT_REQUESTS`, count `scout_manager_fields::SCOUT_REQUEST_COUNT`, 17 bytes) with fewer than 3 reports (`scout_request::REPORT_COUNT`, signed); with `so_vencidos`, only if the request date (`scout_request::DATE`: day, `scout_request::DATE_YEAR`: year) is before today (`G_CURRENT_DATE`, unsigned year, signed day). Returns 1 or 0. Null player: the original routine (box at line 0x5da). The original's local date (`exe::date_date_54a110`) only fills the key after the pair.

`TRAINING_MANAGER::update_coach_assignments(club, tecnico)`, called by the coach hirings and departures (`exe::contract_manager_resolve_contract_offers`, `sign_contract`, `exe::transfer_manager_move_player_to_club`, the regen `player_regen_retire_from_non_playing_staff`) and by the club change (`reassign_squad_schedules`): updates the six training staff slots of the human manager and recomputes each category rating. \n Without a manager and with a club without a human (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club` with 1, 1, 0, 0), or a national side club (`exe::database_is_national_team`): nothing. A null manager: the club's (`.manager()`). The human's coach assignments (`exe::training_manager_get_coach_assignments`, six 9-byte slots): (1) the slot whose coach has no non-player sheet (`staff::NON_PLAYER`) or is neither the assistant (`exe::database_get_club_assistant`) nor one of the 5 coaches (`exe::database_get_club_coaches`) is emptied; (2) the assistant and the coaches with a sheet that are not in the slots go into the first empty one with all five categories (0x01010101 and 1); (3) each flagged category gets its rating: 0 (goalkeepers, sheet +0x10) (chance − sheet `non_player::COACHING_TECHNIQUE` + 21) / 2; 1 (tactics, +0x21 and +0x10) (chance + chance + `non_player::COACHING_TECHNIQUE`) / 3; 2 (+0x10) (chance + `non_player::ATTACKING` + `non_player::COACHING_TECHNIQUE`) / 3; 3 (+0x10) (chance + `non_player::COACHING_TECHNIQUE`) / 2; 4 (+0x11) the chance (divisions truncated toward zero; the chance from `non_player_attribute_rating`), the signed byte divided by the divisor for the number of flagged categories (1.0 to 2.0, float), truncated and clamped to 1..20.

`TRAINING_MANAGER::reassign_squad_schedules(manager, old, new)`, when the human manager changes club (`remove_staff_from_club` and 0x68f9c0/0x69ebc0, manager_manager.cpp): reassigns the training schedules of the old and new squads. \n The old club's squad (`exe::database_collect_club_squad`, 50): each valid person (id below `G_STAFF_COUNT`) gets load 50 (`exe::injury_set_training_load`) and slot 6 (goalkeeper with 15 or more, sheet `player_sheet::GOALKEEPER`) or 1 in the training entry; without a sheet, the box (line 0x34c). With a new club: of the manager's ten schedules, the last one of type 6 (`training_schedule::TYPE`) is the goalkeepers' and the last one of type 1 the general one; each player of the new squad with a sheet goes to the goalkeepers' schedule (goalkeeper with 15 or more, if there is one), otherwise the general one (if there is one), otherwise slot 1, with the schedule's load (`exe::training_schedule_get_training_load`) on the fitness sheet; finally the training staff (`FN_TRAINING_MANAGER_UPDATE_COACH_ASSIGNMENTS` with the new club and the manager).

`TRAINING_MANAGER::update_player_training(p, skip)`, called by the player initialisation for the match (`exe::match_player_setup`, match_man.cpp, with 0: every player of every match), by a new injury (`add_injury`) and by the screens: brings the player's training weeks up to date (up to 30). 
 A null person (line 0x18a), without the sheet (0x195) or without a schedule (`exe::training_manager_get_player_schedule` null, 0x1a3): the "Error" box; an id from `G_STAFF_COUNT` on: nothing. A player of a human manager's club without flag 0x20 in +5 of the training entry: the flag, the schedule slot (the goalkeepers' one, type 6, for a goalkeeper with 15 or more; otherwise the general one, type 1; otherwise 1) and its load (`exe::training_schedule_get_training_load`) on the fitness sheet (`exe::injury_set_training_load`). Weeks = training week (`training_manager_fields::WEEK_COUNTER`) − the entry's (+1); none and without `skip`: nothing. With the flag and the club no longer with a human manager: clears the flag, load 50, slot 6 or 1 and the position training stops (`exe::training_manager_set_position_training_rate` with 0). 
 Up to 30 weeks: brings the entry up to date; each category (0..4) has the weight level × 2 + 60 + (coach factor − 100) / 5 (0..200) and, per week, progress rolls: up 1 with weight above 100, draw(210 − weight) < 20, value below (`.determination()`) / 3 and draw(|value| × 2 + 14) < 10; otherwise down 1 with weight below 110, draw(weight + 60) < 20, value above −7 and above (`.professionalism()`) / 3 − 6 and the same last draw (goalkeeper with 19 or more: only with draw(4), or draw(2) in category 4, at zero). 
 The position training items (`exe::training_manager_find_position_training`, 8-byte items: +4 the mask, +6 the rating, +7 the rate) advance per week (or once, with `skip` in the mask): with a positive rate, draw(rate) < 5 gives rating + 2 (up to 20) and the player may complain (club contract `FN_CONTRACT_MANAGER_GET_CONTRACT_FOR_CLUB` without `grievances::UNHAPPY_WITH_TRAINING` in `contract::GRIEVANCES`: by a rate above 50 or an aptitude `exe::training_manager_get_position_aptitude` below 12, with `.professionalism()` below 15, draw(`.professionalism()`) < 10 and no injury `exe::injury_get_player_injury_status`: flag 0x8000 (`exe::staff_contract_apply_event_flags`), −5 on `contract::MORALE` (−100..100) and `exe::news_post_player_unhappy_with_training`); with a negative rate, draw(−rate) < 5 gives rating − 2 and, below 1, the item ends (rate 0, rating 1). It applies the progress (`exe::training_manager_apply_training_progress`) and, with finished items, removes them from the list (the last one into the gap) and re-sorts (qsort `exe::crt_qsort` with 0x8b4e00).

`TRAINING_MANAGER::get_player_schedule(p)`, called by the people's daily update (game_daily_staff_update 0x5ce2d0), by `game_check_players_missing_training` and by update_player_training (`update_player_training`): returns the player's training schedule. \n A null person or one without the sheet: the "Error" box (line 0x6ad) and 0. At a human manager's club (contract `exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, kept in [0xae1080]; manager `club::MANAGER` among the last 16 ids): injured (`exe::injury_get_player_injury_status` = 2), the human's schedule 1, this + 0x4d8 + 0x60e × (`G_STAFF_COUNT` − id − 1); otherwise the one of the training entry's slot (+0, outside 0..9 slot 1); outside the 16, the box (line 0x68f) and 0. Otherwise: injured, schedule 0 (this); otherwise this + 0x9b × slot (signed).

`TRAINING_MANAGER::remove_or_restore_training_progress(p, devolver)`: takes the progress stored in the training entry off the attributes or puts it back, around the player attribute normalisations (`staff_normalise_player_attributes` and `staff_normalise_player_physical_attributes`: on ageing in the people's daily update 0x5ce2d0, in the young regen `regenerate_as_youth_player` and on load), which take the progress off before and put it back after. \n A null person or one without the sheet: the "Error" box (line 0x621). Taking off (`devolver` = 0): keeps the five progress nibbles of the training entry in `G_TRAINING_PROGRESS_SAVED_DELTA_0`..`G_TRAINING_PROGRESS_SAVED_DELTA_4` (0xde1f3c..0xde1f40: category 3, 2, 4, 0, 1) and applies the negated progress (`training_manager_apply_training_progress`); restoring: applies the kept one.

`TRAINING_MANAGER::get_training_attribute_change(p, attribute)`, called by the training screen (0x8b8184): how much the training progress adds to an attribute: the attribute (`exe::staff_get_player_attribute`) minus the same attribute without the training progress (it applies the negated progress, reads, and reapplies the progress), in al. A null person or one without the sheet: the "Error" box (line 0x657) and 0.

`TRAINING_MANAGER::get_position_aptitude(p, mask)` (`this` not used), called by update_player_training (`update_player_training`, the position training complaint) and by set_position_training_rate (`exe::training_manager_set_position_training_rate`): the player's aptitude to learn a position or side: the average of the adaptability (`.adaptability()`) and the attributes the position needs (ratings 1 to 20 through `exe::player_attribute_rating` over the sheet `.player()`). \n Goalkeeper (1) `player_sheet::POSITIONING`, `player_sheet::HANDLING` and `player_sheet::ONE_ON_ONES`, over 4; defence (2, 4) `player_sheet::TACKLING`, `player_sheet::POSITIONING` and `player_sheet::MARKING`, over 4; midfield and attack (8, 0x10, 0x20) `player_sheet::PASSING`, `player_sheet::MARKING`, `player_sheet::TECHNIQUE` and `player_sheet::TEAMWORK`, over 5; 0x40 `player_sheet::MOVEMENT`, `player_sheet::FINISHING`, `player_sheet::TECHNIQUE` and `player_sheet::PLAYER_PACE`, over 5; 0x80 `player_sheet::LEFT_FOOT`, over 2; 0x200 only the adaptability (in al, the upper bytes with the mask); 0x800 `player_sheet::RIGHT_FOOT`, over 2 (truncated divisions). Any other mask: the "Error" box (line 0x945) and 0.

`TRAINING_SCHEDULE::set_type(slot, kind)`: stores the schedule's slot and type and its five category levels from the type's mix. \n The slot (signed, as a dword) at +0, the type at `training_schedule::TYPE` and the five category levels (+4..+8) by the type's mix (jump table 0x8b4f08): 1 general (25 in the first four), 2 to 5 one category at 50 and the others at 10, 6 goalkeepers (50 in the fifth, 0 in the third), 0 and 7 no training (all 0); outside 0..=7 (the −1 of the human's first slot) only the slot and the type. Called by set_default_schedules (`set_default_schedules`, 167 times at the start of the game) and by the training screens.

`TRAINING_MANAGER::set_default_schedules()`, called by the constructor (0x8b0ec0) in a new game (without training.dat): sets up the computer's seven schedules and the ten schedules of each of the 16 human managers, then gives the default names. \n The computer's seven schedules (0x9b bytes each from this; type k in slot k: the computer trains through slot 1, general, and slot 6, goalkeepers, according to the player's training entry) and, for each of the 16 human managers (person `G_STAFF_COUNT` − h − 1, 0x6e-byte record in `G_STAFF_TABLE`), the ten schedules: slots 0 to 5 computed here (types −1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4), 6 to 9 through `exe::training_manager_get_manager_schedule` (types 5, 6, 7, 7). At the end the default names (`exe::training_manager_set_default_schedule_names`). Called by address (`exe::training_schedule_set_type` and `exe::training_manager_get_manager_schedule` in this batch).

`TRAINING_MANAGER::get_manager_schedule(manager, slot)`: returns the human manager's schedule for the slot (0..=9; outside that, 1): this + 0x9b × (slot + 10 × human + 7), human = `G_STAFF_COUNT` − id − 1. Outside the 16 human managers: the box (line 0x68f) and 0. Called by `set_default_schedules` (slots 6 to 9) and by the screens.

`TRAINING_MANAGER::get_coaching_factor(club, category)`, called by TRAINING_MANAGER::update_player_training (`update_player_training`, five times per player in each training update; the value goes in as (factor − 100) / 5 into the weight of the progress roll): the coaching factor of a training category. \n A null club: 0. Without a manager (`.manager()`) or with a computer manager (id below `G_STAFF_COUNT` − 16): 100 (eax carries the upper 16 bits of the manager pointer, as in the original). A human manager: his staff (`exe::training_manager_get_coach_assignments`, six 9-byte slots: id −1 is an empty slot, the category rating at +4 + category); with n coaches with a rating, the sum (16 bits) divided by the nth divisor and truncated (_ftol 0x945640), × 40/7 (`rdata::F64_5_714285714`) and truncated; below 50, 50. Hot on the computer branch: no counter there.

`TRAINING_MANAGER::get_coach_assignments(manager)`: returns the training staff table (six 9-byte slots) of one of the 16 human managers, at this + `training_manager_fields::COACH_ASSIGNMENTS` + 54 × (`G_STAFF_COUNT` − id − 1). \n A null manager: the "Error" box (line 0xa20) and 0; outside the 16 human managers: the box (line 0xa2a) and 0.

`TRAINING_SCHEDULE::get_training_load()`: the schedule's load from its five category levels (+4..+8, signed) with fixed weights, up to 100. \n trunc(+8 × 0.5) − trunc(+4 × −1.3) − trunc(+7 × −0.5) − trunc(+6 × −0.5) − trunc(+5 × −0.5) (constants `rdata::F64_0_5`, `rdata::F64_NEG_1_3`, `rdata::F64_NEG_0_5`; _ftol 0x945640), in 16 bits; from 100 up, 100. Called by update_player_training (`update_player_training`, the human club's player), by set_player_schedule (0x8b2250) and by reassign_squad_schedules (`reassign_squad_schedules`); it goes to the fitness sheet (Injury::set_training_load `set_training_load`).

`TRAINING_MANAGER::apply_training_progress(person, d)`, called by update_player_training (`update_player_training`, each player on each training update) and by `remove_or_restore_training_progress` and `get_training_attribute_change`: adds each category's progress to the player's stored nibble, moving the category attributes, then handles the trained position or side. \n A null person: the "Error" box (line 0x4b3); without the sheet (`.player()`): the box (line 0x4ba); an id from `G_STAFF_COUNT` on: nothing. With the player's 6-byte entry (this `training_manager_fields::PLAYER_ENTRIES` + 6 × sheet id), each category with progress `d[k]` other than zero moves its step (`progress_step` over the stored nibble) on its sheet attributes (those from 1 to 20 by the step, those from −125 to 125 by six times the step; every two steps the attributes move) and stores the nibble plus `d[k]`: 3 (+4 high), 0 (+3 low), 2 (+4 low), 1 (+3 high) and 4 (+5 low). \n Then the position training (`exe::training_manager_find_position_training`): with the learning entry at 15 or more, the position or side of the mask goes to 20 (learnt); below that, it goes back to 1 (training stopped) if more than one position (`player_sheet::GOALKEEPER`..`player_sheet::ATTACKER`) or side (`player_sheet::RIGHT_SIDE`, `player_sheet::LEFT_SIDE`, `player_sheet::CENTRAL`) at 15 or more is still left. Hot: no counter.

`TRAINING_MANAGER::find_position_training(person, out)`: finds the player's first entry in the sorted position training list and returns how many are his. \n A null person, the "Error" box (line 0x995); a null output, the box (line 0x99c); without the sheet (`.player()`), the box (line 0x9a3): 0. Without flag 0x10 in +5 of the player's training entry (this `training_manager_fields::PLAYER_ENTRIES` + 6 × sheet id), the position training mark: 0. Otherwise the binary search (`FN_CRT_BSEARCH`, order 0x8b4e00) of the person's id in the position training list (`training_manager_fields::POSITION_TRAINING_ITEMS`, count `training_manager_fields::POSITION_TRAINING_COUNT`, 8-byte items); not found: 0; found: steps back to the person's first item, stores it in the output and returns how many consecutive ones are hers.

`TRAINING_MANAGER::has_fast_position_training(person)`, called by the people's daily update (game_daily_staff_update 0x5ce2d0): returns 1 if some item of the person's position training (`exe::training_manager_find_position_training`) has a learning rate (+7) above 50; otherwise 0.

`TRAINING_MANAGER::advance_week_counter(&day)`, every day from the day loop (game_main_day_loop 0x5cccd0, with the day of the year of the game date 0xae2c90): on a day that is a multiple of 7 (signed remainder), the training week (`training_manager_fields::WEEK_COUNTER`, 16 bits) goes up by 1; update_player_training (`update_player_training`) catches up each player with the missing weeks. Returns day / 7 (the caller does not read it).

`TRAINING_MANAGER::init_player_entries()`, called by the constructor (0x8b0ec0) in a new game: allocates the 6-byte training entry of every player sheet and puts goalkeepers on schedule 6 and the others on 1. \n Allocates (calloc `exe::crt_calloc`) the 6-byte training entries, one per player sheet (`G_PLAYER_DATA_COUNT` sheets of 0x46 bytes in `G_PLAYER_DATA_TABLE`, the sheet by its id +0), at this + `training_manager_fields::PLAYER_ENTRIES`; without memory, the box (line 0x6e3) and it returns. In each entry it clears bit 0x20 of +5 and sets the schedule slot (+0): 6 (goalkeepers) with a goalkeeping rating (`player_sheet::GOALKEEPER`, signed) of 15 or more, otherwise 1 (general). Each player's first training update (`update_player_training`, which only afterwards redoes the slot of the computer's players) and all of the human club's training use this slot.
